Alasɔ si loɣere maturi Itɔ̃me Bielea fiɛ mafiniki ne, loito lobie sɔ maaɣere me i kawirikɔ̃ sɔ loikote.
Itɔ̃me nɛ loto loɣɛ ne, ɔɣɛ loto sɔ si loabo maturi anɔ ɛɛbɛrɛ Ɣaa?
Ɔwi gɔ ɔ̃ɔnina ira biara nɛ ɔba ɔro kama ne, kukã siare kuwɛ̃ ɔbo i karɔ̃ gamɔ ɔɖuɖu iso gɔ itã sɔ kukã ɔkpɛ̃ wũ gbaã.
Gɔ mainya wũ ɔso ne, makpese makɛlɛ Yerusalem masɛ mapia manyɔnyɔ wũ.
gɔ ɔse nɖe Regu gɔ ɔse nɖe Peleg.
Kosore ɔba ɔ̃atu ɔ̃ ɔse ɔɣere wũ sɔ, ‘Tete, su wũ kaɖekɔ̃ ga loaɣo me si akpi tã me kiniɔ.
’ Nto loɣere mi sɔ gbaã ne, ngbɔ ame i Ɣaa makpabo ana aana isoɣɔ i kpibaradze ɔwɛ̃ saã gɔ lofiniki ɔso ne.
Loto Ewodia gu Sinteke i kukpa sɔ manɔgu so ara karɔ̃ lɛ manyiibi i Bosate ame.
Ne ɔso mi wũ mikpese Ɣaa maturi gɔ minɔ itɔ̃me gbaã, Itɔ̃me Bielea nɛ lobɔ mi iɖi.
Ɣɛɛ su me bara lɛ fɔ maɖabo ma nsɛ mabara fɔ karabara ndɛ̃ ɔwɛ̃.
Ɔluwɛ̃ ne, ɔrɛrɛ̃ ɔwɛ̃ gɔ i siwarã lalaa si iso fiɛ ɔwe i kasarɛkɔ̃ mmɔ ɔsiagu kulu teteree sɔ, “Yesu Nasaretse, be mpia i bo gu-ɔ ndɛ̃?
Ɔbiara gɔ nsɛ ɔbara i Ɣaa mmara iso pia i Ɣaa ame fiɛ Ɣaa ɔ̃ wũ ɔpia i ɔ̃ ame.
Ikɔ nɛmɔ ame ne, Yohanes gɔ nɖe Zakaria ɔbi ɔfɔ silɔ ɔbɔrɛgu i Ɣaa kɔrɛ i fafuĩ ame.
Ɣɛɛ Yesu ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Midaanigã ne mme loɖe!
Nsɛ lokarɛ wũ sɔ ɔbusi mi anɔ sɔ mianya nnɛ ɔso fiɛ ɔkpere mi ɔbɔ sɔ mianyɔ ne ɔri.
Gɔ ɔnya Yesu ne, ɔpɛ agɛgɛ̃ i ɔ̃ katɔ̃.
Ne ɔso kuɖɔɛ si kuɖe nnɛ miatere misiai miɖo, ɣɛɛ mibie siwarã ame karatã mama ana titirio Ɣaa itɔ̃me kanya iɖi.

Kawirikɔ̃ ne wũ manyii, mitã mi adzuni si ayi ku ara wa nɖe asɛɛ, nwa lokote atã ile, nwa nɖe ɔnukuare, nwa lokote atã kuwarɛ, nwa loya, nwa iso i kuira iinina, ara wa nsɛ alɛ ɔnyɔ gu nwa lokote sɔ ɔturi aabara.
Mito mipia kubɛ i awɛ̃ ame ɣɛɛ bobie sɔ boapia mi ɔtɔ i Bosate Yesu iyere ame sɔ mibara ngbɔ mibua.
Ɔwi gɔ lofe ame ne, ɔrɛrɛ̃ ɔwɛ̃ gɔ marɔ sɔ Teuda ɔbara so lɛ ngɔ lobua ɔnya.
Ne ɔsu ndã ikɔi ne, gɔ ɔpɛ Ɣaa siba i ne iti ne, ɔsu ɔtã ma, ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Mifɔ minɛ.
Si boto bobara i Ɣaa mmara iso ne, iyɔ ite sekelee sɔ boɣe wũ.
Ɔrɛrɛ̃ ɔwɛ̃ gɔ nrɔɔ̃ gu ngba loɣe ɔba ɔ̃ kɔrɛ.
Ɔwi gɔ mapia i Betlehem mmɔ ne, Maria ɔwi ɔɣo sɔ ka ɔ̃aɣe ɔbi.
Ne ɔso si wũ isoɣɔ aayi ne, mitã mi adzuni si aɖe awɛ̃, miwe kuɖɔɛ kuwɛ̃ mitã so, si mibara mawɛ̃ i mi siwarã gu kurabarara ame.
Makarɛ wũ sɔ, “Mme iwawãra aabara ate bo bonya fiɛ boafɔ-ɔ boɖe?
Lofɔ loɖe sɔ ɔto ɔ̃aɖe ɔturi bielea ɔtã-ɔ lɛ ɔsande gu ɔnyii i Bosate ame ana.
Bo Ɣaa sɛ ɔɣara so pɔkɔsɔɔ fiɛ ɔba nnyainyɔ.
Ne ɔso wũ mabi mirera so kama i iɣɔsɔrɛ kɔrɛ.
Makpakpɛ̃dze ɔkpakpa gu kaɖe makpakpa ɔsiai ma kama.
Manyii, boto mi i kukpa sɔ misu kuwarɛ mitã mi matɔ̃ɖedze ma nto mapia kubɛ mate mi Kristo masiaidze ngbã isɛ ara.
Alasɔ Ɣaa sigara iɖe na i akaɖe kunu ame, ɣɛɛ ipia i ɔle ame.
” Ne maturi inyɔ mamɔ ana ɔɣɛ ara wa manya i ɔri gu kumɛgɔ ɔɖi so ɔte ma gɔ ɔkpɛti boɖoboɖo ɔtã ma ne.
Ɣɛɛ ne, ise pɔkɔsɔɔ sɔ kato gu karɔ̃ aawã iɖo sɔ maakpasera mmara kakpoi kosoi tsɔra maɖi.
Iiɖe sɔ ɔnya ko inya sɔ loana ɔturi awune ɔɖe me aɖansiɛ, ɣɛɛ loto loɣɛ ngbɔ sɔ si miana iɖi.
Ɔrɛrɛ̃ ɔwɛ̃ ɔwe mmɔ gɔ marɔ sɔ Yosef ɔbɔrɛ i Levi ɔɣekparɛ ame fiɛ ɔbɔrɛ i Kipro karɔ̃ iso.
Gɔ bo ayi wa boawegu ma ɔɔsɔ̃ fiɛ ka boarui ne, mafɔɖedze gu ma mare gu mabi ɔkɔ bo makɛlɛgu ɔpo katɔ̃, ne bo ɔɖuɖu ɔpɛ agɛgɛ̃ bokparama kayi ne.
Ɣɛɛ mifɔ ne lɛ Ɣaa itɔ̃me fiɛ ɔ̃ itɔ̃me iɖe gbaã, ne ɔso ibɔ ikpaki siare ana i mi mafɔɖedze ngbã ame.
Alasɔ ɔ̃ nsɛ ɔtã kuɣɛ̃ ɔbɔrɛ kutã maturi sɛɛ gu malalaa ɔɖuɖu fiɛ ɔsɛ ɔtã kado ɔpɛ ɔtã maturi bɔlɔlɔa gu maturi nyanyarĩa.
Ɔluwɛ̃ ne, makpakpa sinyɔ-ina ma nsi i ma sigaraiyara iso i Ɣaa katɔ̃ ɔta makɔlɛ mafu i ɔ̃ katɔ̃ male Ɣaa.
Ɔwi gɔ i Elisabet kayiri ɔɔfɔ awa akuɔ ne, Ɣaa ɔpia ɔ̃ kpabo Gabriel sɔ ɔkɛlɛ ɔmagɛ̃ gɔ marɔ Nasaret i Galilea karɔ̃ iso.
’ ne, ɔ̃ ame i Ɣaa ɔpia sɔ ɔsɛ ɔ̃aɖi ma si ɔkpese Ɖidze gu isoɖedze iki i Ɣaa kpabo gɔ ɔnya i kadzirimi ga nto katsue kɔrɛ ne.
Ma gu bo ɔnyii ɖɔɛse Onesimo gɔ bofɔ boɖe fiɛ ɔɖe mi ndɛ̃ ɔwɛ̃ to maba maaɣere mi ara wa ɔɖuɖu nto akɛlɛ i katɔ̃ ngbe.
Gɔ mato makɛlɛ katɔ̃ ne, ɔkolo katɔ̃ ɔsɛ iamɔrɛ̃ i iwarĩ ame sɔ ɔ̃isito ɔwo ɔsɛ.
Ɣaa ɔɔsu mma ɔɖuɖu mpia i ɔkolo ame ngbã ɔpia-ɔ i nrɔɔ̃ ame, mi kuwɛ̃ iibakpi.
Nnɛgbe kama ne, gɔ ma Yudase to maɖe ma iyi iwɛ̃ ne, Yesu ɔsɛ Yerusalem.
Gɔ makpere Paulo ne, Tertulo ɔtsɛ ma kanya iɖi sɔ, “Ɔbea, ɔwi dzoroo nɖe ngɔgbe gɔ bopia i isobuɛ ame ala fɔ iwola nɛ asu aɖegu bo katɔ̃ ɔso.
Kokooko ne, Ɣaa iiɖi ara wɛrɛa wagbe ɔte maturi, ɣɛɛ kiniɔ ne, Ɣaa ɔɔki i ɔ̃ Siwarã iso ɔɖi ɔte ɔ̃ katɔ̃memasɛdze sekelea gu ɔ̃ kanyamaɖidze.
Ɣɛɛ sɔ lona i Mose mmara kayirinɔ ne, losɛ lɛ ngɔ nsɛ ɔbara i mmara iso sɔ si loawo ma ɔkpadzɛ̃ ɔbɔ Bosate kɔrɛ.
Si maturi mama to mana kusia gɔgbe igbã i mi iso ne, iikote sɔ bo wũ boana ngɔ losi kuɖo?
Ɔwe i mmɔ ɔ̃ ɔnɔwɛ̃ ayi sina, ne Ɔbosam ɔba ɔ̃ala wũ ɔnyɔ ne.
Mi ne, maturi ara inyɔ kanya misɛ miɣɛ mi atɔ̃me, ɣɛɛ mme ne, loisɛ loɣɛgu kuwɛ̃ atɔ̃me.
Minya i wũ ara ite ame ɔɖuɖu sɔ loiɖe ɔturi gɔ nsɛ ɔɣɛ atɔ̃me siare loɖe.
Bosɛ boɣɛ ana kumɛgɔ mibua misɛ mibuai maturi i kuɖɔɛ ame fiɛ misu mi ɔriinyɔ mipia i Bosate Yesu Kristo ame teteree.
Ɔmagɛ̃ gɔmɔ ame ame ne, kuɛdze ɔwɛ̃ pia gɔ ɔsɛ ɔba atɔ̃meɣɛdze kɔrɛ ɔba ɔ̃atã wũ iti sɔ, ‘Buai me ala wũ matsirise ɔso.
Maturi to maasɛ̃ kulele ala ifɔ̃ nɛ nto ma gɔ maiɣe nnɛ nto iaba i kayi ɔɖuɖu iso ɔso.
Ɔkidza wũ ala ara nyanyarĩa mama wa ana ɔto ɔbara ɔso.
“Ne ɔso ɔkpere mma ɔɖuɖu nto ɔ̃ ɔkɔse kuso ɔwɛ̃ ɔwɛ̃.
” Ɣɛɛ makpakpɛ̃dze ɔkpakpa ɔfɔ ɔkolo kãse gu ɔkolo sate adzuni ɔɖo nnɛ i Paulo ɔɣɛ.
Si lokpi kɔra ne, ilɛ me iɖo sɔ ɔturi aanyɔ ira nɛ iso loawo ndamu ɔɖe pupurii.
Wã nɖe sikpã, sikpã lalaa, ituritsiri, fiɛ iikote sɔ sitia, ɣee itsuɛ pɛ̃ kuiwɛ̃ aabɔrɛ mi i kanya.
“Ɣɛɛ loba aɖansiɛ wa mba ɔrɔrã aɖo Yohanes ɔkpɛ.
Matsɛrɛ lɛ kumɛgɔ i mma lonya Itɔ̃me Bielea karɔ̃kasɛkɔ̃ ɔɣere bo awe, fiɛ mato maya ne isã ana.
Kristo loɖe katɔ̃ iyɔ ne kama mma lofɔ wũ maɖe ata ku ɔwi gɔ ɔ̃aledza ikpese iba.
Midaanigã mi matsirise, ɣɛɛ miya teteree ɔwi biara ame.
Ɔrɔ̃go gɔ nyiri kurã ne, ɔna ɔri ɔyiri kurã mama ku ɔwi gɔ i ɔ̃ ɔrã kuere si ngbã.
Mi maɖabo ana ne, mikã mi karɔ̃ iso makɔse atsue i ira biara ame.
Ne ɔso misɛ miaɣere ɔ̃ marasuãdze gu Petro ana sɔ, ‘Yesu ɔɔɖe mi katɔ̃ ɔkpa Galilea karɔ̃ iso.
Karɔ̃ gamɔ iso maturi ɔnyɔ bo nnya mafɔ bo kukaakɔ.
Nnɛgbe kama ne, Ɣaa to ɔ̃akɔ bo ma lokuti bopia ngbã ɔkɛlɛgu bosɛ boatu mma loɔta fiɛ boasɛ boasarɛgu Bosate i kuɖokpo.
Maturi to maabɔrɛ i kuɣɛ̃kabɔrɛkɔ̃ gu kɔ̃ iyo kabokɔ̃ maba.
Ɔbusi kanya ɔɣɛ amusuora i Ɣaa gu ɔ̃ iyere gu ɔ̃ kasɛkɔ̃ gu mma ɔɖuɖu mpia i kato iso.
Ne ɔso masia ita sɔ maaɖoe katɔ̃memasɛdze magbe.
I Kristo ame ne mise lɛ mma matu sirɛrɛ̃, fiɛ iiɖe kɔrɔ̃ masu matu, ɣɛɛ mi akpi wa manukutu maɖi mi iso nɖe sirɛrɛ̃ dzɛ matu mi i Kristo ame.
Be ɔso makpese mato maɣere mi sɔ daabara nnɛgbe, daati nnɛgbe anyɔ, ɣee daapɛgu nnɛgbe?
Ne ɔso ne, matã wũ mmuai sɔ, “Boiɣe ngbegɔ ɔna ɔ̃ ɔle ɔbɔrɛgu.
Masu so mabua i mma lofɔ Ɣaa maɖe iso ku iyi nɛmɔ.
Lɛ kumɛgɔ ise i mafɔɖedze ikuri biara ame ne, marɔ̃go si malo i mi kasarɛkɔ̃ sɔ maibaɖe ika.
Ɔ̃ ɔkpɛ nɖe kuwarɛ gu ɔle ɔwi daaro.
Masia ita sɔ bokɛlɛ mma loiɖe ma Yudase kɔrɛ boaɣere ma Itɔ̃me Bielea si ma wũ makɛlɛ ma Yudase kɔrɛ maaɣere ma.
Nnɛ i Herodes ɔbara i ne kama gɔ inyanyarĩ iɖo nɖe sɔ ɔtã mamɔɛ̃ Yohanes mapia i iyo.
Botã Ɣaa gɔ nsɛ ɔtã bo isobuɛ iti sɔ ɔbara mi sekelee i ɔri biara iso.
Nwagbe kama ne, lonya iwawãra mama i kato nɛ mba ɣii gbaã.
Ne ɔso si mafɔɖedze ɔɖuɖu ɔba maasakanya fiɛ ɔbiara ɔtsɛ siɖe agbãagbã iɣɛ fiɛ mma loiɖe mafɔɖedze pia i mi ndɛ̃ ne, maibaɣɛ sɔ mito milala?
Mainyagu wũ ikpi kuiwɛ̃ nɛ ɔso maatã wũ kukpi ipɔ, ɣɛɛ maɣere Pilato sɔ ɔɖoe wũ.
Si ngɔ loiɖe fɔɖedze ɔkpere-ɔ sɔ ba ɖegu wũ ara fiɛ atɔrã sɔ aasɛ ne, ibiara nɛ ɔtã-ɔ sɔ ɖe ne, ɖe ɣɛɛ daakarɛ anɔ sɔ isekele ɛɛbɛrɛ iisekele.
Mmɔ iɖe bosu ɔkolo ɔwɛ̃ gɔ nto ɔkɛlɛ Foinike ne.
Ne ɔso makpere katɔ̃memasɛdze mabɔ ma ndɛ̃, ne mapɛ ma maɣere ma sɔ madaasiɖe ika kuiwɛ̃ i Yesu itɔ̃me iso fiɛ manyua ma ne.
Ma nɖe mma nsɛ masiai Sɛrɛrerɔ̃ Ibi makɛlɛ kakɔi biara ga ɔsɛ ne.
Ɔkpakpa gɔgbe ɔfɔ bo ku isoɣɔ, ɔnyɔ bo iso akpɛnɛ atɛ ɔɖuɖu.
Ne ɔso matsɛ Yesu kama iti, alasɔ ɔsa ɔturi ku Iwarãyi.
Nnɛgbe loatã sɔ miawo nnɛ nlɛ iɖo ɔɖi, sɔ iyi nɛ i Kristo aaba ne, ɔ̃anya sɔ mise sekelee fiɛ ɔ̃ibanya ikpi kuiwɛ̃ i mi iso ne.
Ɣɛɛ si Ɣaa Siwarã ɔle ame nto losa siwarã lalaa ne, mitsue kukaakɔ sɔ Ɣaa sigara ɔɖewi ɔɔba ɔ̃abo mi ndɛ̃.
Ɔse mɔmɔ iisɛ ɔɣɛgu kuwɛ̃ atɔ̃me, ɣɛɛ ɔsu atɔ̃me iɣɛ ɔle ɔɖuɖu ɔpia i Ɔbi nrɔɔ̃ ame.
Ne kama ana ne, kuwɛ titiiti kuwɛ̃ pia i bo gu-ɔ inyɔ ndɛ̃.
Mawɛ̃ ɔkarɛ sɔ, “Be iɖe boabara mmagbe?
Nto loɣɛ nnɛgbe si maana katetere fiɛ maabara mawɛ̃ gu ma malaa i kuɖɔɛ ame.
Ne ɔso Maria ka ɔwegu Elisabet awa atɛ ɔɖui fiɛ ɔkpese ɔkɛlɛ ɔ̃ aɖe.
Ne karɔ̃ ana nɖe sɔ, Kristo mafɔɖedze ma loɔkpi ana ɔwɔ.
Ɣɛɛ ne, Ɣaa ɔwegu wũ, fiɛ ɔɖi wũ ɔbɔrɛgu i ɔ̃ inyɛwe ɔɖuɖu ame.
“Bosate Ɣaa ɔle ɔɖuɖu Sate gɔ mpia fiɛ ɔ̃ɔwe ɔnya.
Maturi gbodzoo ɔba maasakanya i mmɔ ana, ne ɔte ma Itɔ̃me Bielea lɛ kumɛgɔ ame ɔsɛ ɔbara awe ne.
Si Timoteo ɔba mi kɔrɛ ne, mifɔ wũ kukaakɔ alasɔ Bosate karabara kaɖe ɔto ɔbara lɛ kumɛgɔ nto lobara awe.
Alasɔ ngɔ loisɛ ɔwarɛ Bosate Siturina fiɛ ɔsɛ ɔɖe boɖoboɖo gɔgbe ɣee ɔnɛ i ikɔi nɛgbe kanya ne, ɔsɛ ɔɖe, ɔnɛ atɔ̃me iɣɛ ɔtã so.
Ɔrɛrɛ̃ ɔwɛ̃ rɛ i mmɔ gɔ ɔto ɔnyɛ akɔ sitɛ farafana.
Ɔɖoe wũ alasɔ ɔ̃ ɔnyiibi ɖe ɔturi bɔlɔlɔa ɣɛɛ ɔ̃ ɔɖe ɔturi lalaa.
Ɔɖe bo rabaradze laa gɔ lobara Kristo karabara i ɔnukuare ame i bo kanya.
“Ɣaa makpabo ɔɖuɖu si masɔrɛ wũ.
Ira iwɛ̃ nɛ nse lɛ ɔtɔ sinyagɛmi ɔɣɛɣɛ so iba iasia i ma ati iso.
Ngɔi mɛ boisɛ bowarɛ ne, me kɔra bosɛ bodzuɛ̃ kukaakɔ boɖo ne.
Katɔ̃memasɛdze ɔbara awawãra gu akparĩ gbodzoo i maturi ndɛ̃.
Gɔ mabore mabo ɔmagɛ̃ kosoi gɔmɔ ne, Yesu ɔbara lɛ ɔfe ɔto ɔfe awe.
Makɛlɛ Felike kɔrɛ sɔ maaɖi Paulo aɣɛrɛ ɔɖuɖu mate.
Kiniɔ ne, sibɔlɔlɔ dzɛ loba ne, lofɔ sɛ̃ lokigu i Kristo kafɔkaɖe ame, sibɔlɔlɔ dzɛ lobɔrɛ i Ɣaa kɔrɛ ne, kafɔkaɖe iso siki.
Miisɛ mimɔɛ̃ ɔ̃ itɔ̃me mipia i mi situ ame, alasɔ miifɔ ngɔ ɔpia katɔ̃me miɖe.
Alasɔ i mi ngbã mɛ ame miɖe mawɛ̃ ku Kristo ne, loɔkpese mi ɔse ala mme losu Itɔ̃me Bielea lobɔ mi.
Si mibara ngbɔ ne, iyɔ mito miawe i sinyii ame ku Ɔse gu Ɔbi inyɔ.
Ɣaa atɔ̃me iɣɛyi ɔɔɣo, fiɛ Ɔ̃ maturi iso iasɛ karɔ̃.
Ɔ̃ nɖe ikpawaĩ nɛ loaɖi fɔ kuɖɔɛ ite maturi ma loiɖe ma Yudase ne.
I ɔri gɔgbe iso ne, ato aɣɛrɛ Kristo sɔ atã manyii fɔɖedze ma kafɔkaɖe nna ɔle to maana imararãso i ma situ ame.
Ne maɣere wũ sɔ, “Yohanes itupie itɔ̃me nɛ ɔɣɛ iɖe bofɔ.
Ɣɛɛ mitã bosu bo isɛguso bobuai so iso i kuɖɔɛ ame.
” Ne gɔ Yesu ɔnya sɔ mato mabie sɔ maaba maamɔɛ̃ wũ sigara i so ɔle ame ne, ɔrui i ma kɔrɛ ɔkɛlɛ kube iso ɔ̃ ɔnɔwɛ̃.
Mila gu adzuni nyanyarĩa ite maturi, sirerɛ ikpɛ̃ gu sitia si sidaawe i mi ndɛ̃.
Wũ mabi ɖɔɛse, mikɛlɛgu i katɔ̃ miwe i ɔ̃ ame sɔ si ɔwi gɔ ɔɖusi ɔbɔrɛ ne, boawo ɔya i ɔ̃ katɔ̃ ku katetere fiɛ kunuarɛ iibakpɛ̃ bo.
Loito lonyɔ ɔri sɔ iyo kere maapia me i Bosate Yesu iti, ɣɛɛ lotɔrã sɔ maɖoe me i Yerusalem ala ɔ̃ ɔso.
Mamɔɛ̃ ma kubarara mama mato i akɔi gu awabui gu ndu abui ifore iso.
Ne ɔso ita i kiniɔ ito ikɛlɛ ne, misɛ ngbã i Ɣaa kuɖɔɛ kanya ne iiɖe ɔturi ara wa nsɛ akpɛ̃ wũ ɔkã kanya.
” Gɔ lofiniki sɔ si lonyɔ ngɔ nto ɔɖegu me ika ne, lonya sikãrɛtɛa sikaniɛdziri ikɔdzɛ.
Mibara lɛ kumɛgɔ nsɛ lobara wũ ira biara fiɛ loisɛ lota loya kuwɛ̃ iso.
Si loawo nnɛgbe ɔbara ɔso ne, losɛ lokpɛ̃, losu ɔle siare gɔ ɔɖuɖu i Kristo ɔtã me fiɛ ɔto ɔbara karabara i wũ ame.
Miɣe kumɛgɔ boɖe ɔɣiã, mapia bo kunuarɛ i Filipi fiɛ boba boabo mi kɔrɛ i Tesalonika mmɔ.
Si ɔsande aɖe fiɛ Bosate ɔkpere-ɔ ne, ka aɖe ngɔ mba iwarã i Ɣaa ame.
Ne sɔrɛdzekpakpa pelepele ɔledza iɣɛ sɔ, “I Ɣaa iyere ame ne, nto lokã ndamu lotã-ɔ sɔ, ɣere bo si fɔ nɖe Kristo gɔ nɖe Ɣaa Ɔbi.
Mabiara wũ, fiɛ Ɣaa ɔtara wũ ɔɖi i makpise ndɛ̃ i akpɛnɛ atɛ kama i Ɣaa itɔ̃me kanya.
Ɣɛɛ si ɔrɔ̃go ɔya teteree i ɔ̃ kafɔkaɖe ame ku kuɖɔɛ fiɛ ɔbara so sekelee ɔbɔ so karɔ̃ ne, ɔ̃aki i ɔ̃ kuɣe ame pɔkɔsɔɔ.
Si inya sɔ mme wũ losiai ma ne, iyɔ bo ɔɖuɖu ka boakɛlɛ.
Maina ɔri mabo i iyo alasɔ maturi ɔɣede.
Fiɛ si iti ikparɛ̃ sɛ ibɔ ɔrɔ̃go anɔ karɔ̃ ne, iyɔ ɔnyi ɖuku iti.
Iwarãyi iwɛ̃ ne, Yesu ɔsɛ ma Farisise ɔkpakpa ɔwɛ̃ iyo gɔ makpere wũ sɔ ɔba ɔ̃aɖe ara.
Misɔrɛ ɔ̃ gɔ lobara kato gu karɔ̃, ɔpo gu siwore dzɛ nto sibore sife ɔɖuɖu!
Maɖoe Ɣaa kanyamaɖidze ma loɣɛ masɛ sɔ Ɔsekelea to ɔ̃aba.
Gɔ mma mpia i mmɔ ɔnya iwawãra nɛ i Yesu ɔbara ne, maɣɛ sɔ, “Gbaã ne, Kanyaɖidze gɔ sɔ ɔto ɔ̃aba i ngbe ne!
Gɔ miɔfɔ Kristo Yesu lɛ mi Sate ne, mibaragu wũ mawɛ̃ i mi kasɛ ame.
Bo Ɔse Ɣaa mɔmɔ gu Bosate Yesu si mabusi ɔri matã bo sɔ boaba mi kɔrɛ.
Ɔsɛ ne karɔ̃ i Galilea, ne ɔ̃ɔbɔ ne i ngbe ana ne.
Ara wagbe igbã to aaba, ɣɛɛ iite sɔ kawirikɔ̃ ɔɔɣo.
Ne ɔso ibiara nɛ maɣɛ i idududu ame ne, ito iaba i inyamɔ.
Maturi ayere itsɛrɛ ɖeakatɔ̃ nɛgbe ame ne, abã ɔkpakpa gɔ marɔ sɔ Kirenio nto ɔɖe Siria karɔ̃ iso.
Matsɛrɛ mapia i mi mmara ɔko ame sɔ si maturi inyɔ ɔɖe aɖansiɛ i ira iso ne, iyɔ ma itɔ̃me ɖe ɔnukuare.
Si lokpese loto lobara ira nɛ losɛ̃ sɔ iilɛ ne, iyɔ mme mɔmɔ loɔte so sɔ ngɔ loisɛ ɔbara i mmara iso loɖe.
Alasɔ ɔwi gɔ i Yona ɔɣere ma Ɣaa itɔ̃me ne, mafiniki i ma ara lalaa wa mato mabara ame.
Si ɔrɔ̃go ɔrere sɔ ɔ̃ibanyi ɖuku iti ne, iyɔ ɔmɔɛ̃ ɔkpariɛ̃.
Ɔwi gɔmɔ to ɔ̃awe ɔle ɔtã marɔ̃go ma nto nyiri gu matalɛpo ma nto mabi ɣɛtɛ.
Ne ɔso kiniɔ ne, manyii, minyɔ mi ndɛ̃ si miɖi marɛrɛ̃ ikɔdzɛ ma anɔ lokpa fiɛ Siwarã Bielea ana pia i ma ame.
Ne Yesu ɔɖi ma inyɔ mawɛ̃ ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Mikɛlɛ ɔmagɛ̃ ame, mito mianya ɔwɛ̃ sore ndu kabui.
gɔ ɔse nɖe Henok gɔ ɔse nɖe Yared.
Ɣaa masɔrɛdze ɔnyi atɔ̃me gbodzoo masia Yesu iso.
Ne ɔso gɔ maturi gbodzoo mamɔ ɔnya sɔ Yesu ɣee ɔ̃ marasuãdze na i mmɔ ne, mata mabo i sikolo ame makɛlɛ Kapernaum sɔ maanyɔnyɔ wũ.
Ne Petro ɔɣere wũ sɔ, “Mi gu fɔ sikã ɔɖuɖu si miwɔ!
Fiɛ ɔturi biara gɔ nsɛ ɔbɔ so karɔ̃ ne, Ɣaa to ɔ̃akɔlɛ wũ kato.
Gɔ Pilato to ɔbie sɔ ɔ̃abara ma kuɖɔɛ ɔso ne, ɔnyua Baraba ɔtã ma.
gɔ ɔse nɖe Melea gɔ ɔse nɖe Mena.
Gɔ marui ne, maiwo kuwɛ̃ ɔɣere i ɔri iso, alasɔ ifɔ̃ ɔmɔɛ̃ ma.
Ma Farisise gu ma Yudase tsɔra siai ma mawa kubarara gɔ manyua masɛ ma.
” Ɣɛɛ Adam tsɔra gɔgbe ne, ɔ̃ nɖe Siwarã dzɛ nsɛ sitã ngbã ne.
Ifɔ̃ siare ɔmɔɛ̃ ɔ̃ magbamikui itã sɔ itɔ̃me nɛgbe ɔki ikã Yudea simagɛ̃ dzɛ i abe iso abuiti ɔɖuɖu ame.
Herodes ana ɔkpesera wũ ɔsese alasɔ ɔ̃inya kuira lalaa i ɔ̃ iso.
Minyɔ kuɖɔɛ wodoroa gɔ igbã i Bo Ɔse ba ɔtã bo!
Si ɔɔtu sirɛrɛ̃ fiɛ Ɣaa ɔkpere-ɔ ne, fɔ ne ngbɔ.
Sɛ i karɔ̃ si atsɛrɛ sɔ akuku siru kere loɔkuti aatã.
Manya sɔ ɔ̃ marasuãdze mawɛ̃ si mato maɖe ara ku nrɔɔ̃ ɣɛa mɛ maifore i mmara kanya.
Midaanyɔ wũ lɛ ɔbiɛtɛ ɣɛɛ mibuai wũ sɔ ɔ̃ irisɛ aasɛ katɔ̃ i isobuɛ ame sɔ ɔ̃aba ɔ̃atu me alasɔ nto lonyɔ ɔri sɔ ma gu bo manyii tsɔra aaba.
Ngbɔ ame si iyo irere maturi ɔta maɣɛ so iso mato makpɛ̃gu so ne, iyo nɛmɔ to iasasame.
Ne Yesu ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Kasɛ̃ gagbe ne, mi ɔɖuɖu to miatere minyua me, ikuti wũ ɔnɔwɛ̃, alasɔ Ɔko Sekelea ɔɣɛ sɔ.
Marɔ̃go sekelea ma losu ma situ masia i Ɣaa iso ku koko ɔwi ne, ngbɔ makɛrɛ so iki i karɔ̃ ibɔ so itã ma marã ame ne.
Bonɔ ana sɔ mafɔɖedze ɔba ɔmɔɛ̃ i ngbe ɔkɛlɛgu masɔrɛdze makpakpa.
Gɔ ɔ̃ mɔmɔ ba aɣɛrɛ i siri agbãagbã iso ɔso ne, ɔsɛ ɔna ɔtu ɔtã mma loiɣe nnɛ maabara gu mma nto mayu ɔri.
Si boɣɛ sɔ Ɣaa kɔrɛ ɔna ɔle ɔbɔrɛgu ne, ɔto ɔ̃akarɛ bo sɔ, ‘Be ɔso fiɛ miifɔ wũ miɖe?
Ɣaa Siwarã sɛ sinyɔnyɔ ira biara sitsue fiɛ siɣe ta Ɣaa ara wɛrɛa.
Ɔwi gɔ i Herodes ɔnɔ atɔ̃me wagbe ne, ɔ̃ wũ ɔɣɛ sɔ, “Yohanes gɔ lotã matu iti ɔɖe loɔta ɔba ngbã ana!
Ara wɛrɛa wa mpia i ɔ̃ ɔtu ame to aabɔrɛ aba ɔgbami itã sɔ ɔ̃abɔ sɔ karɔ̃ ɔpɛ agɛgɛ̃ ɔle Ɣaa ɔɣɛ sɔ, “Gbaã, Ɣaa pia i mi ndɛ̃!
Ikpɛnɛ tɛare iso ne, masɛ maanya wũ i ma Yudase isɔrɛyo gɔ ɔ̃ gu ma Yudase maratedze mawɛ̃ si.
Mma mpia i ɔkolo ame aaɖe lɛ maturi alafa anyɔ gu sikɔdzɛ-ikuɔ.
Midzuɛ̃ Mi Isɛguso.
I Griki siɖe ame ne, marɔ wũ Dorkas gɔ karɔ̃ nɖe Kuɔ.
Alasɔ kusia gɔ i ngbã sɛɛ isɛ sɛ mikpadzɛ̃ mibɔ nɖe ara sɛɛ ibara, ara ibara i ɔri iso, gu ɔnukuare iɣɛ.
Ne ɔso mmara mɛ i Kristo ɔtã bo nɖe sɔ, ɔbiara gɔ nto ɔɖɔɛ Ɣaa si ɔɖɔɛ ɔ̃ ɔnyii ana.
“Mmɔ i ɔ̃ ɔse to ɔɣere wũ sɔ, ‘Wũ ɔbi, fɔ ne, bo gu-ɔ mpia ngbe ɔwi biara fiɛ wũ ira biara ne, fɔ ire iɖe.
Ɔɣere ma Ɣaa sigarakaɖekɔ̃ iso itɔ̃me ku katetere, ɔte ma ara i Yesu Kristo iso, fiɛ kuwɛ̃ iitɛ̃ wũ ɔri.
Gɔ manɔ ɔ̃ isosarɛ nɛgbe ne, manyɛse ma mpia i karɔ̃ gamɔ ɔɖuɖu iso ɔba Paulo kɔrɛ, ne ɔsa ma ne.
Mi maɣese gu manyiibi gu mi mɔmɔ malɛdze gu mi malaa to maaɖi mi matã.
“So si siɣɔ mma nɣe sɔ mawɛrɛba maɖe i Ɣaa itsue ame.
gɔ ɔse nɖe Obed gɔ ɔse nɖe Boaz.
Minɔgu so ara karɔ̃, fiɛ si ɔrere ɔɣɛrɛ mi ne, misu mitsɛ wũ lɛ kumɛgɔ i Bosate ɔsu mi akpi ɔtsɛ mi.
Ayi wamɔ ɔɖuɖu ne, Yesu ɔsu ɔte maturi ara i Ɣaa kasɔrɛkɔ̃.
Wũ kato ikɔlɛso i mi iti sɔ miabara mawɛ̃ ku Kristo Yesu ɔso nto loɖi nnɛgbe loɣɛ.
Ɣɛɛ nnɛ nto lotsɛrɛ loɣere mi nɖe ngɔ nɖe ɔnyii fɔɖedze fiɛ ɔto ɔɖe asɔrɔ̃, ɔbɛbɛ anɔ, ɔsɔrɛ aɣɔ ɣee ɔrɔ maturi ayere lalaa, ɔrɛ̃ ndã, ɔyu kayu ne, mibɛse so i ɔ̃ iso.
Si ɔrere ba itɔ̃me i siɖe agbãagbã ame ne, ma inyɔ ɣee itɛ kere si ma nɣɛ isia isia.
Sikpã ɔkpɛ̃ mma loiɖe ma Yudase, fiɛ fɔ sikpã ɔwi ɔɔɣo.
Gɔ Ɣaa mabi ɖɔɛse miɖe ɔso ne, mipia kubɛ sɔ miare wũ.
Alasɔ i wũ kasɛ ne, Kristo losi ngbã lotã, ɣɛɛ si lokpi kɔra ne, iaɖe kusia gbodzoo itã me.
Misu mi manyii akpi mitsɛ ma lɛ kumɛgɔ i Ɣaa ɔsu mi are ɔtsɛ mi iki i Kristo iso.
i kuɖokpo gu karɔ̃ iso ɔɖuɖu.
Loɔkpi lonya, ɣɛɛ ne, ka losi ngbã mɛ nna katui.
Ɔwi gɔmɔ ame ne, Ɣaa makpabo ɔso maba maabuai wũ mapia wũ ɔle.
Misa manyɛse i ɔmagɛ̃ gɔmɔ ame si miɣere ma sɔ, ‘Ɣaa sigara ɔɖewi ɔɔbore ɔbo mi.
Gɔ borui i Tiro ne, boba boatui i Ptolemai.
Ɔbiara gɔ loisɛ ɔwarɛ Ɔbi iisɛ ɔwarɛ Ɔse gɔ lopia wũ katɔ̃me.
Ne ɔso mi kafɔkaɖe gu anɔ ka asia i Ɣaa iso.
“Bosate Ɣaa gɔ nɖe ɔle ɔɖuɖu Sate, fɔ kurabarara ɔmɔ fiɛ kuse ɣaa gbaã.
Si mase i kuɣa ame fiɛ maipie ndu ne, maibaɖe ara.
Ne lotã sɔ gbodzoo i mi ndɛ̃ to manyɛ, somina na ma ɔle, fiɛ mawɛ̃ ana ɔɔkpi ne.
Wũ manyii ɖɔɛse, midaafɔ ɔbiara gɔ loɣɛ sɔ Ɣaa Siwarã pia i ɔ̃ ame miɖe, ɣɛɛ mifafarɛ minyɔ sɔ Siwarã dzɛmɔ ne, Ɣaa kɔrɛ sibɔrɛ, alasɔ mila kanyamaɖidze gbodzoo ka mapia i kakɔi biara.
“Masɛ maɣɛ sɔ, ‘Ɔrɛrɛ̃ gɔ losɛ̃ ɔ̃ ɔre si ɔtã wũ ɔko gɔ loate sɔ ɔ̃ɔsɛ̃ ɔ̃ ɔre.
Maturi gbodzoo ɔbɔrɛ i Yudea karɔ̃ iso gu ma ɔmagɛ̃ siare gɔ nɖe Yerusalem makɛlɛ fafuĩ ame sɔ maakã Yohanes itɔ̃me atsue.
Mi nɖe Ɣaa kanyamaɖidze mabi, fiɛ Ɣaa mɔmɔ lonyi kanya ku mi mawa ɔkigu i ɔ̃ kanyamaɖidze iso.
Iyɔ si kaba kaaro ne, Ɣaa aafɔ mi ɔpia i ɔ̃ kasɛkɔ̃.
Ɔwi gɔmɔ ame ne, fɔɖedze ɔwɛ̃ pia i Damasko gɔ marɔ Anania.
Ana ne, mi kafɔkaɖe si katã sɔ Kristo aana kasɛ i mi situ ame, si mi kuɖɔɛ si kure siɖu sɔ miaya teteree.
Iiɖe kumɛgɔ boto boɖɔɛ Ɣaa nɖe kuɖɔɛ, ɣɛɛ kumɛgɔ i ɔ̃ ɔɖɔɛ bo fiɛ ɔsu ɔ̃ Ɔbi ɔsese bo sɔ ɔ̃aɖe ngɔ iso iaki fiɛ boana akpi kasukatsɛ ne, ne nɖe kuɖɔɛ ne.
Si ngbã mɛgbe ame ɔnɔwɛ̃ boba ɔriinyɔ i Kristo ame ne, iyɔ bo nɖe mma mba nnya boɖo pelepele i kayiiso.
ikpese ita nyaa gu nnɛ lofɔ ma kuɣa iɖo atsɔra?
“Kuwɛ̃ iisɛ ɔtsue ɔkãniɛ ɔsu ɔwɛrɛra ɣee ɔfu ara.
Ɔse ɔbara ngbɔ sɔ si maturi ɔɖuɖu aawarɛ Ɔbi lɛ kumɛgɔ masɛ mawarɛ Ɔse.
Alasɔ Ɣaa kuɖɔɛ kuɖe sɔ ɔ̃ Ɔbi ame maanya ɔ̃ kumiamia ɔɖuɖu makigu.
I ɔrɔ̃go itsue ame ne, ɔrɛrɛ̃ ɔsu sikã siwɛ̃ ɔkɔla fiɛ ɔsu sikutia ɔba ɔ̃apia i katɔ̃memasɛdze nrɔɔ̃ ame.
Ira ka iwɛ̃ nɛ ana ɔso bosɛ bopɛ Ɣaa siba nɖe sɔ ɔwi gɔ boɣere mi Itɔ̃me Bielea ne, miifɔ ne lɛ itsuɛwo.
Ɔri ka nto loɣo sɔ loanyɔ kumɛgɔ maawo karabara ɔbara ne ɔso loibawo ɔba.
Mme, Ɔturi Awune Ɔbi, to ɔsɛ ɔ̃akpi lɛ kumɛgɔ ame i Ɔko Sekelea ɔte.
“Iiɖe David itɔ̃me nɛgbe to, alasɔ gɔ ɔ̃ɔsɛ ngbã ɔbara Ɣaa mɔmɔ kuɖɔɛ ne, ɔkpi mabiara wũ, fiɛ ɔ̃ sosina ana ɔburi.
Mi kafɔkaɖe i Bosate ame gu mi karabara se lɛ ara wa mafɛ̃ matã wũ, fiɛ wũ ima maasu mafere i ara fɛ̃a iso.
Midaanigã si minɔ kakpã kulu gu maturi ita iya so iso.
Alasɔ si maɣe ne ne, tee maibapɛ Bosate mamatãra i kudziri iso.
Matindza wũ maya wũ iso sɔ ɔfɔ ɔnyigbã gɔ i Yesu sore si ɔsiai wũ i kama.
Ne ɔto ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Midaafɔ sikã i maturi kɔrɛ miɖo kumɛgɔ i mmara ɔkarɛ.
Lɛ mabi ma nsɛ makã Ɣaa atsue ne, minyua ara wa lola ɔɔkpɛ̃ mi ɔkã ku ɔwi gɔ miiɖe mafɔɖedze ɔbara.
Gɔ manɔ kulu gɔgbe ne, maturi gbodzoo ɔtere makɛlɛ mmɔ.
Ne ɔso mibore mibo Bosate gɔ nɖe ita nɛ mba ngbã fiɛ iire kuira i mayotsuedze anɔ, ɣɛɛ ne i Ɣaa ɔɖi, fiɛ ɔ̃ katɔ̃ ne, ne lofɔ kuɣa iɖo.
So ɔɣɔ mi ɔwa Abraham gɔ ɔtsue sɔ loto loaba.
Nsɛ lopɛ Ɣaa siba ɔwi biara i mi iti ala nnyainyɔ nɛ ɔtã mi iki i Yesu Kristo iso.
Ne ɔso ne, ɣere bo si ɔri pia sɔ boatã Kaisaro lampo.
Kiniɔ ne wũ manyii, i ɔko gɔ mitsɛrɛ me i Ɣaa Siwarã karatã iso ne, loito lobie sɔ kuira aawɛrɛ mi.
Ne ɔso Bosate ɔɣere wũ sɔ, “Mi ma Farisise ne, misɛ mifore mi aɖerɔi gu akɔi kama ɣɛɛ ne, mi ame ɔyigu ɔtile gu anyanyara ɔɖuɖu ibara.
Manyii, ito ibo bo so sɔ iɔfɔ ayi gɔ boinya mi anɔ ku anɔ.
Ɣaa itɔ̃me wɛrɛa nɛ maɖi mate ne, iba kuɣa gbaã fiɛ ɔturi kuwɛ̃ iibawo ne ɔsɛ̃.
Ne ɔso mabo i ikpibiɔ ame, ɣɛɛ mainya Bosate Yesu kpise.
Kasɔrɛkɔ̃ matɔ̃ɖedze gu mmara matedze mawɛ̃ ɔnyɔnyɔ ɔri gɔ maaki fiɛ maamɔɛ̃ Yesu maɖoe.
Ne ɔso i Bosate iyere ame ne, loto loka mi sɔ midaasɛ ngbã lɛ mma loiɖe ma Yudase fiɛ ma adzuni ɔnyanyarĩ, ma adzuni ame se guduu.
Gbaã ne, Ɣaa nɖe nukuarese fiɛ ɔsɛ ɔtã bo ngbã mɛ nna katui.
” Ne ɔkɔ Petro gu Yakobo gu Yohanes ɔruigu, ɔtsɛ so imararã iti ikpakpa ne.
Kiniɔ ne, kpɛ̃ ta si akɛlɛ ɔmagɛ̃ ame ne mato maaɣere-ɔ nnɛ ikote sɔ aabara.
“Mawɛ̃ ana ɔnɔ Ɣaa itɔ̃me lɛ ɔraɖui gɔ losia i karɔ̃ sɛɛ iso.
Fiɛ si Ɣaa iitara Kristo ɔɖi i makpise ndɛ̃ gbaã ne, iyɔ mi kafɔkaɖe na kusia kukuwɛ̃, fiɛ mikpese mipia i mi akpi ame.
Minɔ ɔriinyɔ itɔ̃me nɛgbe koko ku ɔwi gɔ maɣere mi ɔnukuare itɔ̃me nɛ nɖe Itɔ̃me Bielea.
Si ɔrere ɔɣɛ sɔ ɔɣe wũ, ɣɛɛ ɔ̃isɛ ɔbara i ɔ̃ mmara iso ne, ladze i ɔnyiiɔ ɖe, fiɛ ɔnukuare na i ɔ̃ ame.
Alasɔ iki i ne iso ne, makpakpɛ̃dze ɔɖuɖu ma nto madzuɛ̃ igara iyo gu maturi ɔɖuɖu i ngbe ɔɔtsue sɔ Kristo ɔɖabo loɖe ɔso lorɛ i iyo.
Mma ɔɖuɖu lonya nnɛgbe ɔtsɛ Yesu iɣɛtɛ iɣɛ sɔ, “Ɔrɛrɛ̃ gɔgbe to ɔkɛlɛ ɔ̃abo i kpibaradze iyo.
Bo ɣɛɛ ne, Ɣaa sigarakaɖekɔ̃ mare boɖe, fiɛ bosi bosia bo Ɖidze gɔ nɖe Bosate Yesu Kristo sɔ ɔ̃abɔrɛ i kato ɔba.
Ne ɔrɛrɛ̃ gɔmɔ to ɔɣere wũ sɔ, “Ɖɔɛ Bosate Ɣaa ku fɔ ɔtu ɔɖuɖu ku fɔ siwarã ɔɖuɖu ku fɔ ɔle ɔɖuɖu ku fɔ adzuni ɔɖuɖu ana si aɖɔɛ fɔ ɔnyii lɛ kumɛgɔ ato aɖɔɛ so.
Ne ɔso miisiɖe mafɔ ɣee marisɛdze, ɣɛɛ mi gu Ɣaa maturi ɔɔkpese Ɣaa ɔmagɛ̃ gu ɔ̃ iyo maturi.
Ɔɣɛ ɔsɛ kokooko ɔkigu i ɔ̃ kanyamaɖidze sekelea iso sɔ.
Ne ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Isobuɛ itã mi.
Kiniɔ ne, wũ matsirise ma loito mabie sɔ loɖe sigara ne, mibɔ ma i wũ katɔ̃ miba miaɖoe.
“Ne ɔɖabo gɔgbe ɔɣere wũ sɔ, ‘Su fɔ kuso gɔ ato ɔko bɔ.
“Manyii, mi ma nɖe Abraham mabi gu mi ma loiɖe ma Yudase ɣɛɛ misɛ miwarɛ Ɣaa ne, mikã atsue si minɔ!
Gɔ ɔkɛlɛ sɔ ɔ̃akpura ma ne, ɔkarɛ ma sɔ, ‘Wũ maturi, manyiibi miɖe, ne ɔso minyua ɔkpɛ̃.
Ne kama ne, lonya Sɛrɛrerɔ̃ Ibi gɔ iɣɛ i Zion kube iso.
“Mose gɔ masɛ̃ fiɛ makarɛ wũ sɔ, ‘Nna loɖi-ɔ bo isoɖedze gu atɔ̃meɣɛdze?
“Si loɖe so aɖansiɛ ne, iyɔ wũ aɖansiɛ iibaɖe ɔnukuare.
Nto loɣere mi sɔ ne, Ɣaa kanyamaɖidze gbodzoo gu magara ana ɔbie teteree sɔ manya ara wa mito minya, ɣɛɛ mainya, ɣee si manɔ ara wa mito minɔ, ɣɛɛ mainɔ.
Misɛ̃ ɔturi Sekelea gu Ɔbɔlɔlɔa, ɣɛɛ minɔ karɔ̃ sɔ ɔnyua turiɖoese i ɔ̃ kanya ɔtã mi.
Ɣɛɛ gɔ ma ndɛ̃ ɔwɛ̃ ɔnya sɔ ɔ̃ɔna isosarɛ ne, ɔpɛ ɔfiniki ɔto ɔle Ɣaa ku silɔ teteree.
Gɔ masɛ iti ame i itɔ̃me iso ne, manyi Yesu fiɛ makɔ wũ makɛlɛgu Roma abã ɔkpakpa Pilato.
Kumɛgɔ mibara i mmara iso ɔso fiɛ Ɣaa ɔsu ɔ̃ Siwarã ɔtã mi ɔto ɔbara awawãra i mi ndɛ̃, ɛɛbɛrɛ kumɛgɔ minɔ ɔ̃ itɔ̃me fiɛ mifɔ ne miɖe ɔso?
Ɣaa itɔ̃me ɔɣɛ isɛ sɔ, Ɣaa to ɔ̃abara mma loiɖe ma Yudase bɔlɔlɔ iki i kafɔkaɖe ga maba ɔso.
Ɣaa ɔbara nnɛgbe si ɔsu ɔte ta mma maiɣe mabɔ kayi sɔ kuira na gɔ ikategu ɔ̃ abualɛra gu kayiribielea ga ɔba ɔtã bo ala Kristo Yesu ɔso.
Siwarã ɣɛ teteree, ɣɛɛ siturina ɔɔfɛ̃.
Ɣaa gɔ lokpere mi sɔ mikpese ɔ̃ mare aabuai mi ɔsɛ ɔ̃abo kawirikɔ̃.
Ɣɛɛ ɔmama pia gɔ nsɛ ɔɖe me aɖansiɛ fiɛ loɣe sɔ nnɛ ɔsɛ ɔɣɛ i wũ iso ne, gbaã iɖe.
Ɣaa ɔsu ira biara ɔpia i Kristo ngba kayirinɔ fiɛ ɔsu wũ ɔtã mafɔɖedze ikuri lɛ Sate gɔ mba ɔle i ira biara iso.
Gɔ ɔnɔ maturi gbodzoo to mafe ne, ɔkarɛ sɔ, “Be nto iba?
Midaatã bokɔlɛ so kato, ɣee bopia so sikpã, ɣee bokpɛ̃gu so sirerɛ.
Ayi gbodzoo kama ne, ma Yudase ɔsɛ iti ame sɔ maaɖoe wũ.
Kiniɔ ne, O Bosate, nyɔ anɔ wa mato makɛkɛ mapia bo!
Aɣe sɔ mawɛ̃ pia i mmɔ gɔ mato mate ara wa loakpɔkpɔtɔra bo ara ite i Kristo kafɔkaɖe iso.
Ɣɛɛ ne, maiɣe ɔbi ala Elisabet ɖe ɔlɛma fiɛ ma inyɔɔ ana ɔɔsɛ katɔ̃ i akɔ ame.
Fiɛ si maturi iisibata mabɔrɛ i makpise ame gbaã ne, iyɔ lɛ kumɛgɔ mapɛ igbã sɔ ne, “Mitã boɖe si bonɛ, alasɔ kɔrãkaɖe boto boakpi,” ɖe ɔnukuare.
Ɔbɔ so karɔ̃ lɛ ɔturi awe ɔkã atsue isɛ iabo ta kukpi ame, kunuarɛ kukpi gɔ ɔkpi i kudziri iso.
“Loɖi karɔ̃ lote ma ɔluwɛ̃ sɔ ma Romase mmara iitã ɔri sɔ maatã ɔturi ipɔ fiɛ maaɣɛgu wũ atɔ̃me.
Ɔto ɔɣere ma sɔ madaatã lampo gɔ i ma Romase igarakpakpa ɔsia.
Ɣɛɛ ne, boɣe sɔ iiɖe ngɔ nsɛ ɔbara i mmara iso nɖe ɔturi bɔlɔlɔa, ɣɛɛ ngɔ lofɔ Kristo Yesu ɔɖe.
Ngɔ mpia i sia si ɔdaaɣɛ sɔ ɔsɛ kaa sɔ ɔ̃asu awu.
Ɣaa nɖe kuɖɔɛ, fiɛ ɔbiara gɔ nsɛ ɔɖɔɛ maturi ne, ɔpia i Ɣaa ame fiɛ Ɣaa ana pia i ɔ̃ ame.
Ngɔ lopɛ ara i sosina ɔkã kanya ne, kukpi nɖe nnɛ ɔ̃abɛse ɔɖi i ne ame.
Ɔmagɛ̃ gɔ matsue masia i kube iso ne, ɔ̃ibawo ɔwɛrɛ.
Fiɛ ara wa i Ɣaa Siwarã sɛ sibie ne, wã wũ ata aɣɛ i nwa i sosina sɛ sibie iso.
Bosɛ bofɔ maturi aɖansiɛ boɖe, ɣɛɛ Ɣaa aɖansiɛ ba ɔrɔrã aɖo, fiɛ ɔsia itɔ̃me nɛgbe ita i ɔ̃ Ɔbi iso.
Mitɛ̃ra atsue i Ɣaa itɔ̃me iso lɛ kumɛgɔ i mi mase ɔbara.
Atoa sɔ iiɖe ɔsɛ̃ misɛ̃ sɔ miito mibuai me ku ɔwi gɔmɔ ame ne, miina ɔri sɔ miasese me karatã.
Minɔ sɔ siwarã dzɛmɔ to siaba kayiiso fiɛ kiniɔ ne, ka sipia i ngbe koko.
Ara Ite Isegu I Kuyiri Iso.
Ɣaa kpabo ɔwɛ̃ ɔɖi so ɔte ma fiɛ Bosate ifiɛ ɔfere ma ibɔrɛ i kato.
Mma nɖe Kristo Yesu mare ne, maɔpɛ ma iso sina mamatãra i kudziri iso gu sɛ̃ ara wa nsɛ akpɛ̃ sɛ̃ ɔkã ɔɖuɖu.
Gɔ ɔnya Petro gu Yohanes to mafe mabo iyo ne, ɔkarɛ ma sɔ matã wũ sikã.
Wã nɖe aɣɛ kuere wa lofɔ iyere sɔ Ɔbosam gu Satana gɔ losɔsɔla kayiiso ɔɖuɖu ne.
Ne Yesu to ɔpɛ ma igbã iwɛ̃ sɔ, “Mikarã inɔ i kuɖedziri gu adziri agbã mama iso.
” Gɔ ɔtsue sɔ Yesu ɔbɔrɛ i Galilea ibuiti nɛ iso i Herodes to ɔɖe ne, ɔsu wũ ɔsese Herodes ala ɔba ɔpia i Yerusalem ku ɔwi gɔmɔ ame.
Inyɛwe nɛ mina i mi maturi nrɔɔ̃ ame ne, ngbɔ ame i mma mpia i Yudea karɔ̃ iso fiɛ mafɔ Yesu maɖe ɔwe inyɛ i ma Yudase nrɔɔ̃ ame ne.
Ne ara wa mba ngbã aka ana iwɛ̃ ɔsu sikãrɛtɛa arɔi akɔdzɛ wa ame i Ɣaa gɔ mba ngbã fiɛ ɔpia ɔwi biara sikpã pia ɔtã Ɣaa makpabo ikɔdzɛ magbe ne.
Mma nto makpɔkpɔtɔra mi kumɛgɔgbe ne, magɔ̃ so kere si iro!
Iikote sɔ ɔ̃aɖe fɔɖedze ɣɛtɛ sɔ ɔ̃aba ɔ̃akɔlɛ so kato fiɛ iaki i ne iso sɔ ɔ̃aba ɔ̃akpase lɛ kumɛgɔ i Tsirise ɔkpase awe.
Ira nɛ i Mose mmara iiwo ɔbara Ne ɔso minyɔ kukaakɔ!
Ato aaya i Kaisaro katɔ̃ asu fɔ itɔ̃me asɛ wũ i katɔ̃.
Si loɔna kɔrɔ̃ kukaakɔ ne, loatã makpere-ɔ matã me.
Ne Yesu to ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Ɔko Sekelea ame ara wa minɔ loka ngbe ne, nɔme kaɖe gagbe iba i ne ame.
Maturi mama ma loifiniki sɛ manigã ma ibore ibo, ɣɛɛ mala maɔwarɛ ma.
Gɔ mabo kayogodɔ̃ ga masɛ marɔ Kulɛ Kayogodɔ̃ ne, manya ɔrɛrɛ̃ ɔwɛ̃ gɔ nɖe bafã ita i ɔwi gɔ maɣe wũ.
Si misɛ miɖɔɛ mma nsɛ maɖɔɛ mi ɔnɔwɛ̃ ne, be kuso miafɔ i Ɣaa kɔrɛ?
Ma Yudase masɔrɛdze gbodzoo ana ɔfiniki masiai kafɔkaɖe gagbe.
Ɔwi gɔmɔ ame kɔra ne, so iiɣɔ Ɣaa i ma mawɛ̃ iso ala ma nsɛgbai ɔso.
Gɔ ɔkolo katuikɔ̃ gamɔ iilɛ katã sɔ maaya idzoro ala ɔyu ɔwi ka ɔba ɔso ne, marisɛdze ɔsia ita sɔ maarui makɛlɛ Foinike.
Si lobara wũ karabara ku ɔtu ɣɔa ne, iyɔ loanyɔ ɔri lotã kuso ifɔ.
Gɔ Yesu ɔnya kumɛgɔ i so ɔma wũ ne, ɔɣɛ sɔ, “Ito iabua iɖa fiɛ ranase aabo i Ɣaa sigarakaɖekɔ̃!
Nnɛ kere makarɛ mabɔrɛgu i bo kɔrɛ nɖe sɔ, bonyigi mawɛrɛba ma mpia i ma ndɛ̃ fiɛ mme wũ ne, ngbɔ ame tutuutu nsɛ lobie sɔ loabara ne.
Maka Mose gɔ nɖe Ɣaa ɔɖabo gu Sɛrɛrerɔ̃ Ibi kuka sɔ.
Maɖe aɣɛ gu ɔ̃ maɖabo iso fiɛ maisina kasɛkɔ̃ i kato.
Kawirikɔ̃ ne, Yesu ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Ngɔ mba atsue si ɔnɔ nnɛ nto loɣɛ.
Ne Yesu ɔɣere wũ sɔ, “Wũ ɔlaa nnɛ ɔso aba ne, tã ipɛ-ɔ siwa si abara ne!
Ɣɛɛ gɔ matã wũ kukpi ipɔ ne, matã sɔ kanyamaɖidze atɔ̃me ɔba i ne ame.
Ɔkɛlɛ Zakaria iyo ɔsɛ ɔ̃aya Elisabet.
Atoa sɔ ise ngbɔ ne, mafɔɖedze ma nɖe mawɛ̃ ku Kristo kasɛ iise ngbɔ.
Ɣɛɛ maladze mawɛ̃ ma mpia i mafɔɖedze ikuri ame to mayu bo manyɔ sɔ isɛguso nɛ boba i Kristo ame ne, maamɔɛ̃ ne mafɔ, makpesera bo masande matã ma Yudase kubarara.
Maaɖe marɔ̃go ma loisɛ marɛ̃ ndã fiɛ masɛ mabara ira biara kukaakɔ.
Iyi iwɛ̃ gɔ Yesu pia ɔto ɔte maturi ara i Ɣaa isɔrɛyo ɔɣere ma Itɔ̃me Bielea ne, masɔrɛdze makpakpa gu mmara matedze gu kaɖe matɔ̃ɖedze ɔba mmɔ.
Bosate Yesu Kristo abualɛra si awegu mi.
“Ne Abraham to ɔɣere wũ sɔ, ‘Fɔ manyiibi ba ara wa i Mose gu Ɣaa kanyamaɖidze ɔtsɛrɛ masɛ.
Mi ma Filipise ɣe kukaakɔ sɔ karɔ̃kasɛkɔ̃ ɔwi gɔ lobɔrɛ i Makedonia fiɛ losɛ Itɔ̃me Bielea imomo ipɛ karɔ̃ ne, mi ɔnɔwɛ̃ pɛ losese me karatã fiɛ mifɔ wũ kusɛkusɛ.
Ngbɔ ame i masɔrɛdze gu mmara matedze ana ɔma wũ maɣere so sɔ, “Ɔɖi mawɛ̃, ɣɛɛ ɔ̃ito ɔwo so ɔɖi!
Atoa sɔ Ɣaa ɔbi ɔɖe ne, iki i ɔ̃ inyɛwe ame ne, ɔsuã sɔ ɔ̃akã Ɣaa atsue.
Ɣɛɛ Ɣaa loɖi araɖea ɔɖuɖu sɔ mma lofɔ wũ maɖe gbaã fiɛ masiai ɔ̃ itɔ̃me si maaɖe ku siba ipɛ.
Bo nɖe mma lotu sirɛrɛ̃ i ɔnukuare ame, alasɔ boto bosɔrɛ Ɣaa i ɔ̃ Siwarã ame fiɛ boba isoɣɔ i ngbã mɛ bosi i mawɛ̃ ibaragu Kristo Yesu ame.
Ne ɔso si makpere Yesu iyere ne, mma ɔɖuɖu mpia i kato gu karɔ̃ gu kayi ga mpia i karɔ̃ kayirinɔ ɔɖuɖu aapɛ agɛgɛ̃.
Kaya tutuutu ne, masɔrɛdze makpakpa gu kaɖe makpakpa ɔbara adzuni sɔ maaɖoe Yesu.
Ɔ̃ nɖe ngɔ loasu ibɔradziri ɔɖe kayiiso ɔɖuɖu iso ne.
Ɣɛɛ ne, itɔ̃me siɖu iibo karɔ̃ kukaakɔ.
Ne ka ɔtã mapɛ Yesu kukaakɔ fiɛ ɔsu wũ ɔtã sɔ makɛlɛgu wũ maapɛ mamatãra i kudziri iso ne.
Daatarĩgu kato ala mmɔ nɖe Ɣaa sigaraiyara ne.
Kaɖesɛ̃a ne, bota bokɛlɛ Kaisarea, bosɛ boabo Itɔ̃me Bielea ɣɛdze Filipo iyo.
Ikpɛ̃ ta Ɣaa makpabo ɔkã sɔ maatsue ira i ara wagbe iso.
Fiɛ si isɛ karɔ̃ i bo iso ne, nda iawirigu mma loifɔ Ɔ̃ Itɔ̃me Bielea maɖe?
Ɔpia mamama ana, mapɛ mawɛ̃ fiɛ maɖoe matsɔra.
Nto loaki i Makedonia fiɛ loabo mi kɔrɛ alasɔ loɣɛ sɔ loaki i mmɔ tɔtɔ.
Isɛ ire ibɔrɛ, imɔ ibara kadzirimi ga lomɔ kaɖo i ayo ame kakpɛkɔ̃ ga matɛ̃ ɔkpã mapia ame, kata akpa katã ɔyu sɔ kato kurodzai aabara ayo i kã ame.
gɔ ɔse nɖe Nahum gɔ ɔse nɖe Esli.
Si boɣɛ sɔ ikpi kuiwɛ̃ na i bo iso ne, boto bosɔsɔla so, iyɔ ɔnukuare kuwɛ̃ na i bo ame.
Iba ana sɔ igara ɣɛtɛ gɔ loiɣe Yosef ɔtsɛ iɖe iso i Egipte.
Gɔ ɔkpese ɔba marasuãdze itɛ mamɔ kɔrɛ ne, ɔnya sɔ maɔrɛ sirɛ, ne ɔɣere Petro sɔ, “Ne ɔso miibawo me ɔsɛ ɔdzuɛ̃gu bidɛ ɔɖɔwũ ɔwɛ̃?
Iwarãyi iso ne, mawarã lɛ kumɛgɔ i mmara ɔte awe.
Fiɛ ayi atɛ kama ne, ɔto ɔ̃aledza ita ibɔrɛ i makpise ndɛ̃.
Gɔ kutsuɛ ɔɣo ne, Yesu gu ɔ̃ marasuãdze ɔbɔrɛ i ɔmagɛ̃ ame.

Fiɛ fɔ ngɔ fɔ nɖe wũ rabaradze laa ana ne, buai marɔ̃go inyɔ magbe, alasɔ maɔbuai me gbaã i Itɔ̃me Bielea iɣɛ ame ku Klemens gu wũ marabaradze laa ɔɖuɖu ma ayere loibawo ɔrɔ, ɣɛɛ ma ayere pia i Ɣaa magbanadze ɔko ame.
Mma i Ɣaa ɔkpere ɔbɔrɛgu i idududu ame ɔbɔ ɔ̃ ikpawaĩ siare ame.
Ɣɛɛ si miibawo so ɔɖe iso ne, miyiri marã gu marɔ̃go si minyua ɔtsue ala mi ɔrakolo ɔso.
Miɣe sɔ Kristo ne, ɔba sɔ si ɔba ɔ̃asu kayiiso akpi ɔkɛlɛgu, fiɛ ɔ̃ mɔmɔ na ikpi kuiwɛ̃.
So si siɣɔ mma anɔ lorɛtɛ i Ɣaa kuɖɔɛ ibara iso.
Nnɛgbe loate ma sɔ mato maawɔ, ɣɛɛ mi mito miana ngbã, alasɔ Ɣaa nsɛ ɔtã miɖe iso.
Alasɔ Siwarã Bielea to siate mi nnɛ miaɣɛ si ɔwi gɔmɔ ɔɔɣo.
Mmɔ i Siwarã Bielea ɔbo i ɔbi ɔse Zakaria ame ɔɣɛ ɔsɛ sɔ.
Mmɔ i Yesu ɔfiniki ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Yerusalem marɔ̃go, midaabiɛ me.
Maturi ɣɛ i mmɔ mato manyɔ fiɛ ma Yudase matɔ̃ɖedze ana to mabara Yesu aɣiãra sɔ, “Ɔɖi maturi mama, ne ɔso si ɔ̃ nɖe Kristo gɔ i Ɣaa ɔsia ikparĩ ne, ɔɖi so si bonyɔ!
Samaria marɛrɛ̃ gu marɔ̃go gu mabiɛtɛ ɔɖuɖu sɛ mawarɛ wũ ala ɔ̃ kurabarara ɔso.
Bokɔse Ɣaa to ɔ̃asɛra wũ sigara lɛ ɔ̃ ɔwa tɛtɛ David awe.
Alasɔ ma wũ mato maakpere-ɔ lɛ kumɛgɔ akpere ma sɔ maba maaɖe ara.
Yesu Ba Kuɖɔɛ Ɔtã Yerusalem.
Nda ibara fiɛ boto bonɔ maɖe ika i bo abuiti siɖe ame?
Mi mɔmɔ nɖe ikparĩ nɛ loate sɔ Bosate Katɔ̃mesɛdze loɖe.
Misore wũ nsɛgbai i ara wa misuã gu nwa mifɔ mibɔrɛgu i wũ kɔrɛ, wũ ikaɖe gu kurabarara ame.
Silɔ dzɛmɔ ɣere wũ sɔ, “Mme nɖe Yesu gɔ ato akpɛ̃gu teteree ne.
gɔ ɔse nɖe Nahor gɔ ɔse nɖe Seruk.
Si maiɣe ɔnyiiɔ kɔra ne, ilɛ wũ iɖo!
Ikpɛnɛ nyɔare kutsuɛ gɔ Iwarãyi ɔɔro ne, Maria Magdalase gu Maria gɔ nɖe Yakobo ɔnyi gu Salome ɔsɛ maaɣa korobo sɔ maasɛ maasɔla Yesu.
” Ɔluwɛ̃ ne, ɔsarɛ, ɔsu ɔ̃ ɔkala ɔtsɛ isɛ.
Ne Yesu ɔkarɛ wũ sɔ, “Be ɔso fiɛ ato akpere me Ɔbielea?
Lonya ɔpo gɔ nse lɛ aɣɔɣɔɛ wa ame lorɛtɛ lɛ ɔtɔ.
Mibɔ so karɔ̃ si miɖe maturi ɣɔa ana ne, mina ɔtu.
Ɣɛɛ gɔ ma Yudase ɔta maya ne iso ɔso ne, itã sɔ loɣere ma sɔ loasu wũ itɔ̃me lokɛlɛgu Igarakpakpa Kaisaro katɔ̃.
Ne Bosate ɔwe i ma ame, ɔsɛgu ma sɔ maɖi ɔ̃ Itɔ̃me Bielea mate iki awawãra agbãagbã wa mabara i ɔ̃ ɔle ame ne.
Gɔ lonya wũ ne, lobɔrɛ lofere i ɔ̃ ngbatɔ̃ lɛ kpise, ɣɛɛ ɔsu ɔ̃ kuɖearɔ̃ ɔsia me iso ɔɣere me sɔ, “Daanigã!
Ɔɣere mma loiɖe ma Yudase fiɛ madzorogu Ɣaa gu ma Yudase ma lobore mabo wũ.
Ne Yesu to ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Si mito mikparama kayi ne, miɣɛ sɔ.
Mma nto maɣɛ itɔ̃me ku adzuni sɛɛ ne, kuɖɔɛ ɔso mato maɣɛ ne, alasɔ maɣe sɔ Ɣaa ɔpia me sɔ lokpɛ̃ i Itɔ̃me Bielea iti.
Ɔ̃ masiaidze ana ɔki nrɔ̃ ɔɖuɖu iso maɣɛ ɔ̃ Itɔ̃me Bielea.
Ɔsi wũ mmara sɔ, “Daaɣere kuwɛ̃ nnɛ loba.
Maɣere wũ sɔ, “Abolo kuboi kukɔdzɛ boba.
Bonɔ ɔɣɛ ana sɔ ɔrɛrɛ̃ gɔ lobɔrɛ i Nasaret fiɛ marɔ wũ Yesu ne, ɔto ɔ̃abiɛ Isɔrɛyo nɛgbe fiɛ ɔ̃afinikira Mose mmara mɛ ɔtã bo.
mata sɔ maakpɛ̃gu Ɣaa gu ɔ̃ Kristo.
Nwagbe ɔɖuɖu to aakpese fɔ are si abɔ iti karɔ̃ atã me.
Fiɛ ira biara nɛ mabara i iwɛrɛ ame to iare kayi.
Miɣe sɔ iiɖe sikãfudza, ɣee sikãrɛtɛa dzɛ nsɛ sinina siɖe i Ɣaa ɔsu ɔtã mi iti kuso fiɛ ɔɖi mi ɔbɔrɛgu i ngbã mɛ i mi mawa ɔsɛ fiɛ mina kusia kukuwɛ̃ ame.
Manyii, mi mɔmɔ miɣe sɔ bo mi kɔrɛ iba ne, iiɖe siefe.
Ɔwi gɔgbe ame i Kristo Siwarã ɔki i ma iso sitã maɣɛ ara masɛ kumɛgɔ i Kristo aawe inyɛ fiɛ ne kama, ɔ̃ana ikpawaĩ siare.
Ɔbiara gɔ loafɔ Itɔ̃me Bielea nɛ ɔɖe, fiɛ ɔ̃afɔ Ɣaa itupie kubarara ne, ɔ̃ana iɖi.
Mmɔ i Ɣaa makpabo ikɔdzɛ ma nto arɔi akɔdzɛ ɔwɛ̃ ɔba wũ kɔrɛ ɔɣere me sɔ, “Ba nyɔ kumɛgɔ maakpadzɛ̃ asɔrɔ̃ɖedze siare gɔ nsi i ndu gbodzoo iso kutsue.
Akɔ anyɔ kama ne, maɖi Felike, ne masu Porkio Festo masɛra i ɔ̃ kanya ne.
Ne kama ne, maɖansiɛ inyɔ magbe ɔnɔ silɔ teteree siwɛ̃ ɔbɔrɛ i kato siɣere ma sɔ, “Miba i kato ngbe!
Fɔ ɔrɔ̃go gɔ fɔ nɖe fɔɖedze ne, iawo ɔki i fɔ iso sɔ aaɖi fɔ ɔrã gɔ loiɖe fɔɖedze.
Nnɛgbe ɔbara ma ɣii, ne ɔso matsɛ Ɣaa ile.
Minyigi sɔ mito miafɔ kaɖekɔ̃ lɛ mi kuso, alasɔ Bosate Kristo mɔmɔ mito mibara karabara mitã.
Iyɔ maibaɣɛ inyakpi kuiwɛ̃ i mi iso.
Ne ɔso ana ne, maisu ndã ɣɛtɛ mafere i bɔi ɔko akpo kuere ame.
Ɣɛɛ Festo ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Yorɛdze Paulo pia i Kaisarea, fiɛ mme wũ loto loakɛlɛ mmɔ i ɔwi kurukutu ame.
Ne Yesu ɔpɛ ma igbã nɛgbe sɔ, “Ɔwi ɔwɛ̃ ne, ɔrɛrɛ̃ ɔwɛ̃ ɔkpɛ̃ adziribi kakpɛkɔ̃.
Ɣɛɛ daasusu isɔrɛyo katɔ̃, alasɔ masu mmɔ matã mma loiɖe ma Yudase fiɛ maatutui sikpatɔrɛ̃ i ɔmagɛ̃ sekelea iso awa sina-inyɔ.
Matu-ɔ sirɛrɛ̃ o-o, maitu-ɔ sirɛrɛ̃ o-o ne, iiɖe ne lonya, ɣɛɛ nnɛ lonya iɖo nɖe sɔ aɖe ɔturi ɣɛtɛ.
Gɔ ma ɔɖuɖu ɔɔɖe mami ne, ɔɣere ɔ̃ marasuãdze sɔ, “Mimala kupupui ɔɖuɖu ne midaatã kukawɛ̃ si kanina.
Gɔ masɛ i ɔri mato makɛlɛ ne, manya ɔ Kirenese ɔwɛ̃ gɔ marɔ Simon gɔ ɔbɔrɛ i akorowa awɛ̃ ɔto ɔba Yerusalem.
Ne makarɛ so sɔ, “Iiɖe ɔrɛrɛ̃ gɔgbe ɔɖe mpia ɔto ɔɖoe Yesu masiaidze i Yerusalem ayi wa lofe ɣɛɛ?
Ɣɛɛ si bo, ɣee kpabo gɔ lobɔrɛ i kato ɔɣere mi Itɔ̃me Bielea mama nɛ loikotegu nnɛ boɣere mi ne, Ɣaa si ɔwɔra wũ pelepele.
Si mamɔɛ̃ aɣɛ ɣee si manɛ ndu lalaa ne, iibabara ma kuira.
Bɛrɛ mme ɔɖe?
Ngɔ loya ɔsia i isã si ɔdaanina ɔwi sɔ ɔso ɔba iyo sɔ ɔ̃asu kuira i iyo kame.
Ne ɔsu ndã ikɔi ne, gɔ ɔpɛ Ɣaa siba i ne iti ne, ɔsu ɔtã ma, ne manɛ ne.
So si siɣɔ mma kama i maturi sɛ mati ala Ɣaa kuɖɔɛ ibara ɔso.
Si ɔ̃ ɔrã gɔmɔ ɔkpi ne, ɔ̃awo kurã mama ɔyiri si ɔbie.
Atoa sɔ lokpɛ̃gu wũ, lotia wũ, fiɛ loɣɛ anyakpi i ɔ̃ iso ku ɔwi gɔ lofe fiɛ loaba loafiniki ne, Ɣaa ɔnyɔ me nnya alasɔ ɔwi gɔmɔ ame ne, loifɔ wũ loɖe fiɛ loiɣe nnɛ loto lobara.
Si mipia ɔraɖui i karɔ̃ ame ne, iisɛ ire si iiɖe katɔ̃ iburi.
Ɔwi gɔ ame i Herodes ɔɖe sigara i Yudea karɔ̃ iso ne, Ɣaa sɔrɛdze ɔwɛ̃ ɔwe gɔ marɔ Zakaria.
ne lokpese ita nɛ lofɔ kuɣa iɖo ata ɔɖuɖu ne.
Ɣɛɛ lona kuira pɔtĩ nɛ loatsɛrɛ losese Igarakpakpa i ɔ̃ iso.
Ɣɛɛ Bosate ɔfedza abualɛra gbodzoo ɔfere me iso fiɛ ɔtã me kafɔkaɖe gu kuɖɔɛ, ara wa nɖe bo are si bobara mawɛ̃ ku Yesu Kristo.
Midaabara ara wa loabo Ɣaa Siwarã so alasɔ sɛ̃ i Ɣaa ɔsu ɔsɛ mi ikpo sɔ ɔ̃afɔ mi ku iyi tsɔra iso ne.
Masɛrɛkɔdze ɔkpese makɛlɛ mato male Ɣaa makɔlɛ ɔ̃ iyere kato i ira nɛ manya gu nwa manɔ ɔso alasɔ iba ngbɔ tutuutu lɛ kumɛgɔ i Ɣaa kpabo ɔɣere ma.
“Si ɔrere to ɔbie sɔ ɔ̃atsue iyo siare ne, ɔ̃aɖe katɔ̃ ɔsɛ i karɔ̃ ɔbu ara wa ɔɖuɖu lonya gu wã kuɣa ɔnyɔ si ɔba sikã ɔ̃awo ɔtsue ɔro tɔtɔ fiɛ ɔ̃asɛ karɔ̃.
Aɣɛi ɔkã ɔ̃ iso ɔɖuɖu fiɛ masɛ masu wũ maasɛ i ranase gɔmɔ kayogodɔ̃.
Loata lokɛlɛ tete kɔrɛ losɛ loaɣere wũ sɔ, “Tete, lobara ikpi, loɣɛrɛ ɔ gu Ɣaa.
Miɣe sɔ ɔwi gɔ miɖe maɣɔsɔrɛdze ne, mitã ara wa nna ngbã ɔɖe mi iso fiɛ abara karabara i mi iso.
Ne ɔso midaatã sɔ sirɛ aasu mi lɛ mma loiɣe Bosate.
Gɔ Anania ɔnɔ atɔ̃me wagbe ne, ɔluwɛ̃ ɔrɔ̃ ɔfere i karɔ̃ ɔkpi!
Ɔɣere ma sɔ mafiniki i ma situ ame manyua akpi ɔbara si mafɔ ndu ipie kubarara si Ɣaa aasu ma akpi ɔtsɛ ma.
Kristo iipia me sɔ loba loabara maturi Ɣaa itupie kubarara.
Aibawo ɔsɛ ɔdzuɛ̃ iɣo ɔɖɔwũ ɔwɛ̃ pɛ kere?
“Ɣɛɛ iyosate gɔmɔ to ɔ̃aɣɛ sɔ, ‘Loiɣe mi!
Si lopɛ Ɣaa siba i araɖea wa ɔtã me iti ne, be ɔso fiɛ ɔmama aabu sɔ loɣɛrɛ wũ i wã iti gɔ loɔpɛ Ɣaa siba?
Gɔ maɣɛ mato maɣɛ nnɛgbe ne, ɔluwɛ̃ Yesu ɔba ɔ̃aya i ma ndɛ̃.
Miya teteree i mi kafɔkaɖe ame si misɛ̃ wũ alasɔ miɣe sɔ mi malaa fɔɖedze i kayiiso ɔɖuɖu to mawe inyɛ ngbɔ.
Mmɔ mato makarɛ wũ sɔ, “Ratedze, ku mme ɔwi iaba ngbɔ?
Gbaã ne, mma nsi ngbã matã kayi gagbe ara ne, masu ma anɔ masia nnɛ mato mabara iso kɔra maɖo mma nto mabara Ɣaa sigarakaɖekɔ̃ karabara.
Sate ɔwɛ̃ saã gɔ mpia nɖe Yesu Kristo gɔ iso i Ɣaa ɔki ɔbara ara ɔɖuɖu fiɛ ɔ̃ iso iki bosi ngbã.
Siwarã Bielea ɔbo i ma ɔɖuɖu ame matsɛ ikaɖe mato male Ɣaa i siɖe agbãagbã ame lɛ kumɛgɔ i Siwarã ɔtã ma ɔle.
Minyɔ, ngɔ loɖi me ɔtã nɖegu ma katɔ̃.
Mmɔ i Yesu ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Miɖe maturi ma nsɛ mate so lɛ masɛɛ i maturi anɔ.
Aram ɔ̃ wũ ɔɣe Aminadab, Aminadab ɔɣe Naheson, Naheson ɔɣe Salmon.
Mma nto mate sɔ mi ara ba ma ɔmɛrɛ̃ ne, ɔsɔsɔla kere mato mi.
Wũ manyii ɖɔɛse, si ngbɔ i Ɣaa to ɔɖɔɛ bo ne, iyɔ ikote sɔ boaɖɔɛ so.
Uzia ɔɣe Yotam fiɛ Yotam ɔɣe Ahaz, Ahaz ɔɣe Hezekia.
Gɔ ɔkpese ɔba ne, ɔ̃ marasuãdze to marɛ sirɛ ana.
Yesu ɔɣere ɔrɛrɛ̃ gɔ kɔrɔ̃ lokarĩ sɔ ɔta ɔya i ma katɔ̃.
Ɔbiara i Yerusalem ɣe, fiɛ maɔnɔ itɔ̃me nɛgbe.
Midaaɖɔɛ kayiiso ɣee ira biara nɛ nɖe kayiiso ire alasɔ si mito miɖɔɛ kayiiso ne, iyɔ miito miɖɔɛ Bo Ɔse.
Ɔkpɛ tɛare nto lobie sɔ loba mi kɔrɛ ne, ɣɛɛ loito lobie mi ibuai kuiwɛ̃.
Ɔto sikãrɛtɛa itunɛra nɛ loyigu anyanyara gu ara nyanyarĩa wa ɔna ɔbɔrɛgu i ɔ̃ asɔrɔ̃ iɖe ame.
Bo gu Siwarã Bielea dzɛ i Ɣaa ɔsu ɔtã mma nsɛ makã wũ atsue ne, bo nɖe ara wagbe maɖansiɛ ne.
Gɔ mibara mawɛ̃ ku ɔ̃ gɔ nɖe iti ɔtã siwarã ame sile gu mma nto maɖe iso ɔso ne, mi wũ mi ngbã ɔɔyi.
Ne ɔso manyua wũ sɔ ɔwiri si ɔkpadzɛ̃ wũ ɔkɛlɛgu.
Ɔwɛ̃ aakarɛ sɔ, “Nda i makpise aabara fiɛ maaledza ita?
Mabuaidze ma lomɔɛ̃ ma karabara kukaakɔ ne, ma mɔmɔ ba kayakpa fiɛ masɛ mawo kafɔkaɖe gu Yesu Kristo iso itɔ̃me ɔɣɛ ku ɔle.
Atoa sɔ lodzorogu mi fiɛ boito bonya so anɔ ne, lopia i mi kɔrɛ i siwarã ame.
Ne kama ne, Ɔturi Awune Ɔbi to ɔ̃abɔrɛ i adɔdɔ ame gu ɔ̃ ɔle gu ifiɛ teteree ame.
Mila miɔpia kubɛ gbaã ku ɔwiɔ, ɣɛɛ ne, nna kowũ ɔɖe lotɛ̃ mi ɔri sɔ midaakã nnɛ nɖe ɔnukuare atsue?
Ɔ̃ wũ ɔpia i mabuaidze ikɔdzɛ ma maɖi i Yerusalem ndɛ̃.
Ne mawa Kukpi Ɔtakuwara Bo Iyi aɖera masɛ ne.
Iiɖe ɔturi awune loɖi me, fiɛ iiɖe ɔturi iso iki fiɛ lokpese katɔ̃mesɛdze, ɣɛɛ Yesu Kristo gu bo Ɔse Ɣaa gɔ lotara Yesu ɔbɔrɛgu i makpise ame lokpere me.
” Ne ɔɣɛ sɔ, “Tete!
Kukame nɖe .
Ɔsa mma lokpi kasɛkasɛ gu mma lofɛfɛ̃ masi i karɔ̃ ana.
Kuso siare i Ɣaa ɔtã i mi iti ne ɔso midaakpesera so maturi masande.
Kanya iɖaɛ nɛgbe ɔtã sikpã ɔmɔɛ̃ mmara matedze gu ma Yudase makpakpa gu maturi ɔɖuɖu.
Alasɔ ɔwi gɔmɔ ame ne, miimɔ mitã makpakpa aɖera fiɛ ipɛ i kiniɔ ana ne, miito miwo makpakpa aɖera ɔɖe.
Ɔbiara gɔ nsɛ ɔbara ikpi ne, Ɔbosam ɔre ɔɖe alasɔ Ɔbosam ne, ikpi ɔsɛ ɔbara ta karɔ̃kasɛkɔ̃.
Atoa sɔ boba ɔri lɛ Kristo katɔ̃memasɛdze sɔ boasu bo anyaa bokpesera mi ato ne, bomɔɛ̃ so bola lɛ ɔtalɛpo gɔ nɣe ɔ̃ mabi inyaa.
Ne ɔso matu siwɛ̃ dzɛ lomɔɛ̃ abɔra wa manyi mamatãra i ɔkolo iso, fiɛ ka makurisi ɔdziri gɔ masɛ madzuɛ̃ ala ɔkolo makɛlɛgu ngbegɔ masɛ.
Minyɔ wũ nrɔɔ̃ gu ngba si mipɛgu me minyɔ sɔ mme loɖe.
gɔ ɔse nɖe Sem gɔ ɔse nɖe Noa.
Nnɛgbe ɔso nto loapia Timoteo gɔ nɖe wũ ɔbi ɖɔɛse fiɛ ɔsɛ ɔbara Bosate Karabara i ɔnukuare ame ne.
Iiɖe kunuarɛ nto lopia mi i ara wa nto lotsɛrɛ mi ngbe iso, ɣɛɛ ɔka loto mi lɛ wũ mabi ɖɔɛse awe.

Nnɛ nto me ɔkã kiniɔ teteree fiɛ iɖe wũ ɔriinyɔ ana nɖe sɔ, loibasɛ̃ wũ karabara lonya, ɣɛɛ i ɔwi biara ame, titirio kiniɔ ne, loawe katetere gbodzoo sɔ loasu wũ iso sina ɔɖuɖu lopia Kristo kuwarɛ si lopia ngbã ɣee ɔkpi lokpi.
Nnɛ loto loɣere mi nɖe sɔ, ayi kumɛgɔ i ngɔ nɖe biarase ɖe ɔbiɛtɛ ne, ikpaki kuiwɛ̃ na i ma gu maɖabo inyɔ ndɛ̃ atoa sɔ ɔ̃ mba ira biara fiɛ.
David gu ɔrɔ̃go gɔ ɔmɔɛ̃ ɔfɔ i Urea kɔrɛ ɔɣe Salomo.
Si ɔrere ɔɣɛ sɔ ɔsɛ ɔɖɔɛ Ɣaa, ɣɛɛ ɔtsiri ɔ̃ ɔnyii ne, ladze i ɔnyiiɔ ɖe.
Loinya nnɛ ɔbara fiɛ ikote sɔ loatã wũ kukpi ipɔ.
Midaatã ira sɛɛ ibara si itɔrɛ bo, alasɔ si iitɔrɛ bo ne, boto boana ne kusia i ɔwi gɔ lokote iso.
Iyɔ maturi gbodzoo aapɛ Ɣaa siba i bo iti sɔ ɔnyɔ bo nnya ɔkã kayi ikparama gbodzoo atsue.
Tee ɔsu ɔrɔdɛ̃ ɔfɔ ɔturi ikɔ buu kuwakuso gɔ ɔ̃asu ɔtã mawɛrɛba.
Iiɖe ita ana iso iɖe matsɛrɛ masia ɣɛɛ maturi situ iso matsɛrɛ masia.
Alasɔ si miba miasarɛ sɔ mito misɔrɛ Ɣaa ne, ara sɛɛ wa nsɛ abɔrɛ i mi isarɛ ame iisi lɛ ara lalaa.
Ɔɖesɛrã si kaɖe aaɖaɛ ne, Yesu ɔkɛlɛ ngbegɔ i kuwɛ̃ na ɔsɛ ɔ̃akparama kayi.
Marɛrɛ̃ itɛ magbe pɛ nɖe ma Yudase fɔɖedze ma nɣɛgu me i Ɣaa sigarakaɖekɔ̃ karabara ame fiɛ mabua maɖe ibuai siare matã me.
Ana ne, lobie sɔ bie iyo sɛ me alasɔ lofɔ loɖe sɔ Ɣaa to ɔ̃akã mi ɔɖuɖu atsue ɔnyua me ɔtã mi.
Kuɣɛ̃ ba kɔ̃ ifiɛ, fiɛ ɔgbaworeti ana ba ɔ̃ ifiɛ.
Wũ manyii ɖɔɛse, mitã boɖɔɛ so alasɔ Ɣaa kɔrɛ i kuɖɔɛ ɔbɔrɛ.
Ɣɛɛ loibaɖe ndamu fiɛ maturi aaba maabu sɔ loɖe ɔturi siare loɖo kumɛgɔ ikote i wũ ikaɖe gu kurabarara ame.
Aɖansiɛ nɖe sɔ, Ɣaa ɔsu ngbã mɛ nna katui ɔtã bo, fiɛ ɔ̃ Ɔbi ame i ngbã mɛgbe pia.
Kumɛgɔ ame i Ɔse sɛ ɔtara makpise ɔtã ma ngbã ne, ngbɔ ame i Ɔbi ana sɛ ɔtã mma ɔto ɔɖɔɛ ngbã ne.
Alasɔ iba kunuarɛ sɔ ɔrɔ̃go ata ɔya ɔɖe ika i mafɔɖedze ndɛ̃.
Si gbaã iɖe sɔ mifɔ Mose miɖe ne, tee miafɔ me miɖe, alasɔ wũ iso ɔtsɛrɛ ara ɔsegu.
Mabi to maata maya maɣese iso maɖi ma matã sɔ maɖoe.
Mma mpia i Yudea si matere makɛlɛ abe iso, mma mpia i ɔmagɛ̃ ame si matere mabɔrɛ.
Gɔ manɔ ne Ɔbosam ɔmɔɛ̃ ɔɖi i ma iti ame ɔluwɛ̃.
Ne ka maɖi Petro gu Yohanes mabɔ i ma katɔ̃ makarɛ ma sɔ, “Nna iyere gu ɔle ame iɖe mibara ara wagbe?
Fiɛ si Ɣaa ɔɔsu ara ɔɖuɖu ɔpia i Kristo kayirinɔ ɔro ne, Kristo gɔ nɖe Ɣaa ɔbi ana to ɔ̃asu so ɔpia i Ɣaa kayirinɔ sɔ Ɣaa ɔnɔwɛ̃ saã aaɖe ara ɔɖuɖu iso.
” Ifɔ̃ ɔmɔɛ̃ Petro gu matsɔra gbaã sɔ ɔ̃isiɣe nwa ɔto ɔɣɛ.
Fiɛ si gbaã i makpise iibata ne, iyɔ ɔ̃itara Kristo ɔ̃ wũ.
Fiɛ ɔwi biara miɖɔɛ ne, miawo ma ɔbuai.
Mma nɖe kayiiso maturi ne, mase lɛ ngɔ mapɔ maɖi i sise ame.
Nnɛgbe kama ne, lonya bɔi lalaa ɔwɛ̃ gɔ ɔto ɔbɔrɛ i ɔpo ame.
” Ma situ ɔkpase sisɛ, mafɔ wũ mapia i ɔkolo ame kere fiɛ mabo ɔkpokpo ngbegɔ masɛ ne.
Ne Yohanes to ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Ngɔ mba awu aka anyɔ ne, ɔsu awɛ̃ ɔtã ngɔ nna kuawɛ̃.
Kɛlɛ aasu fɔ ira biara rɔdɛ̃ si asu sikã atsɛ mawɛrɛba, si aana kusia siare i kato.
Gbaã ne, loisibanɛ ndã kumiwɛ̃, gbɔgbɔɔgbɔ loanɛ miɣɛtɛ i Ɣaa sigarakaɖekɔ̃.
Atoa sɔ wũ ɔnyɛ ɔɖaa mi ne, mifɔ me fiɛ miwarɛ me.
Ɔbu mito sɔ ɔwi gɔgbe ɔɖuɖu ame ne kanya boto boɖi so?
Ɔwi gɔ i Yesu ɔnɔwɛ̃ ka ɔsi ne, mma nsɛ masiai wũ ɔwi biara gu ɔ̃ marasuãdze iweo-inyɔ ɔba maakarɛ wũ sɔ ɔɖi igbã karɔ̃ ɔte ma.
Ɣɛɛ Bosate ɔɣere wũ sɔ, “Ta si akɛlɛ aabara nnɛ loto loɣere-ɔ.
Nnɛ i ɔkɔse sɛ ɔbie ɔbɔrɛgu i marabaradze magbe igbã kɔrɛ nɖe sɔ maabara ma karabara i ɔnukuare ame.
Filipo Ɔɖegu Etiopia Ɔkpakpa Ika.
Ne Yesu ɔta wũ mmuai sɔ, “Ise lɛ kumɛgɔ aɣɛ.
Ɔto ɔ̃atã sɔ ɔwi gɔ i Bosate Yesu Kristo aaba ɔ̃aɣɛgu kayiiso atɔ̃me ne, ɔ̃atã mi ibɛ.
” Ɔluwɛ̃ ne, manyua ma asabu masɛ marui masiai wũ.
Ɔɖe fɔɖedze gɔ mba kayiribielea fiɛ ɔsɛ ɔtã mawɛrɛba ara ɔwi biara.
Ɣɛɛ misɛ̃ sɔ miibaɣɛ atɔ̃me i ɔri iso fiɛ miiɖɔɛ Ɣaa ana.
Mato mabie awawãra sɔ maanya ɣɛɛ maibanya kuiwɛ̃ iɖo Ɣaa kanyaɖidze Yona ire igbã.
Ma Yudase Iwarãyi ne, Yesu ɔsɛ ma kasarɛkɔ̃ ɔsɛ ɔ̃ate Ɣaa Itɔ̃me.
Ɣɛɛ ɔsia ne ita kokooko ta kayi karɔ̃kasɛkɔ̃ sɔ ne iso ɔ̃aki fiɛ ɔ̃aɖi bo.
Ne Farao ɔbi birɔ̃gomi ɔsɛ ɔ̃ɔnya wũ ɔsu ɔba ɔ̃abara ɔ̃ kayiri ame ɔbi ne.
Fiɛ si fɔ malaa ɔnɔwɛ̃ asɛ aya ne, mme siba ipɛ aba gɔ mma loiɖe mafɔɖedze ma wũ masɛ mabara ngbɔ?
Gɔ Ɣaa makpabo ɔrui makɛlɛ kato ne, masɛrɛkɔdze ɔɣere so sɔ, “Mitã bokɛlɛ Betlehem boanyɔ nnɛ loba fiɛ Bosate to ɔɖi ɔte bo ngbe.
Mmɔ i Ɔbosam ɔla wũ ɔnyɔ akpɛnɛ sina buu ne.
Ne ɔso Siwarã Bielea ɔkɔ Simeon sikɛlɛgu ma Yudase isɔrɛyo.
Mɔɛ̃ atɔ̃me wagbe la si aaɖe iso i Bosate kakpã gagbe ame.
Nto loɣere-ɔ gbaã sɔ ne, aisibanya me gbɔgbɔɔgbɔ ɔwi gɔ miala kulu miɣɛ sɔ, ‘Maale ngɔ nto ɔba i Bosate iyere ame!
Mma Igbã Lokote Mafɔɖedze Matɔ̃ɖedze.
Wũ anɔ ɔrɛtɛ i ɔwa mɛrɛ̃ kubarara iso kukaakɔ sɔ losɛ katɔ̃ loɖo wũ isɛlaa gbodzoo i kubarara itsue ame.
Ne ɔso Saulo ka ɔwe i ma ndɛ̃ faa ɔwi ɔɖuɖu fiɛ ɔɣɛ Bosate itɔ̃me ku kagbegbe i Yerusalem.
Lonya sɔ miinɔ itɔ̃me karɔ̃, alasɔ miiɣe Ɔko Sekelea ame itɔ̃me gu Ɣaa ɔle.
Miaɖe Tsirise ɔle ɔɖuɖu iso fiɛ kuira iibabara mi.
Mma ɔɖuɖu loisɛ masiai ara ite sɛɛ ne, ma ɔso matã mmara ne.
Ifɔ̃ ɔmɔɛ̃ ma gbaã ne maɣɛ sɔ kpise ɔɖe manya.
Iiɖe ɔturi kɔrɔ̃ matsɛrɛ ala ɣɛɛ Ɣaa gɔ mba ngbã Siwarã masu matsɛrɛ ala.
Ne ɔbɔrɛ ɔkɛlɛ ɔsɛ ɔ̃aya i kayogodɔ̃ ne.
Iyi nɛmɔ ame iso ne, Yesu masiaidze inyɔ mawɛ̃ sɛ i ɔri mato makɛlɛ ɔmagɛ̃ kosoi ɔwɛ̃ gɔ marɔ Emaus.
Katɔ̃mesɛdze Ɔle Gu Ɔ̃ Karabara.
Kiniɔ ne, ɔ̃ɔtã iba i ne ame iki i Bosate Yesu Kristo iso.
Si mikã mmamɔ igbã atsue ne, mi kɔrɔ̃ iibapɛgu nnɛ mito minyɔ ɔri.
Ɔ̃ lomɔɛ̃ kubereku ɔɖuɖu ɔsa fiɛ ikpese iyo iwɛ̃, fiɛ ɔ̃ nsɛ ɔtsue iyo ikpese Ɣaa isɔrɛyo sekelea.
Ɔ̃ ɔse Fanuel ɔbɔrɛ i Aser kalɛ ame.
Ne ɔso ne, kuwɛ̃ si ɔdaaɣɛgu ɔ̃ ɔlaa atɔ̃me fiɛ ɔwi aaɣo.
Mifiɛ i ma ndɛ̃ lɛ kumɛgɔ i awãmi sɛ afiɛ i kuɖokpo ame.
Minyigi sɔ mi ma loiɖe ma Yudase ne, ɔwiɔ ne, ma Yudase ma matu sirɛrɛ̃ sɛ matia mi sɔ mma maitu sirɛrɛ̃, ɣɛɛ sirɛrɛ̃ itu nɛgbe ne, sosina ame kubarara kere kuɖe, fiɛ ɔturi kere lobara ala arɔĩ.
Ikote sɔ maakã ara wamɔ atsue mabara i wã iso!
Fiɛ ira biara nɛ i ikpawaĩ ɔɖi ite ne, isɛ ite sekelee manya.
Mma lonɔ itɔ̃me nɛgbe ɔkarɛ Yesu sɔ, “Iyɔ nna loabua ɔna iɖi?
Ne mmɔ i Yesu to ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Miikpa anɔ ɖuɖuuɖu.
Ne Paulo ɔtã wũ mmuai sɔ, “Ooɣo, ɔ Yudase loɖe.
Si David to ɔkpere wũ sɔ ɔ̃ Sate ne, nda iabara fiɛ Kristo aaɖe David ɔ̃ ɔwa tɛtɛ?
Gɔ ɔbɔ so karɔ̃ fiɛ ɔsu so ɔtã ɔso ne, Ɣaa ɔnɔ wũ.
Ibara ɔ Farisise gɔmɔ ɣii gɔ ɔnya sɔ Yesu iifore nrɔɔ̃ lɛ kumɛgɔ i kubarara ɔte kanya fiɛ ɔtsɛ aɖera iɖe.
Marɔ̃go magbe nɖe Maria Magdalene gu Yohana gu Maria gɔ nɖe Yakobo ɔnyi.
Iiɖe Siwarã ame ɔre kere loɖe katɔ̃, ɣɛɛ sosina ame ɔre fiɛ kini i siwarã ame ɔre ɔsiai.
Gɔ mapia mato manyi kanya male Ɣaa ne, Siwarã Bielea ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Miɖi Barnaba gu Saulo misɛ mitã karabara ga ɔso lokpere ma.
Gbagbaã iɖe sɔ Herodes gu Pontio Pilato gu Israel kaɖe gu mma loiɖe Israel maturi ɔsa so kanya i ɔmagɛ̃ gɔgbe ame mata maya i fɔ Ɔɖabo Sekelea Yesu gɔ asɔla nnɔĩ iso.
Mi mɔmɔ minyɔ si ikote sɔ ɔrɔ̃go aaya ɔkparama kayi sɔ ɔ̃ifu so ara iti?
Ɔrɛrɛ̃ ɔwɛ̃ ana ɔwe gɔ marɔ sɔ Anania fiɛ ɔ̃ ɔre nɖe Safira.
Kato gu karɔ̃ to kaafe, ɣɛɛ wũ atɔ̃me iibafe anya ɖa.
Nnɛgbe ɔso lokpere mi si botsue so loɖegu mi ika ne.
Ɔwi gɔ lokpakpa so loro ne, ma Yudase mawɛ̃ ɔba maanya me i isɔrɛyo mmɔ.
” Kumɛgɔ i ɔ̃ awa ibara ɔfɔ ma ati ame ɔso ne, masɛ makã wũ atsue.
Si mito mikpɛ̃gu so sirerɛ fiɛ mito milɔgu so ne, ne kerekere ɔɔte sɔ sosina ara kere misi mitã, fiɛ mikotegu kayi gagbe maturi.
Petro gu Yakobo gu Yohanes gu Andrea mɛrɛ̃ ɔba maakarɛ wũ pɔkɔsɔɔ sɔ, “Bosate, iɖe ɔwi gɔ i ara wagbe aaba?
Ne ɔso mikã wũ atsue i ibiara nɛ ɔ̃aɣere mi ame.
Ne ɔso Yosef ɔsu kpise ɔmini i ɔkati ɣɛtɛ ame, Ɔsu ɔrara i ɔ̃ ikpibiɔ nɛ ɔɖi ɔsɛ so i ita ame, ne ka ɔli ita siare ɔtɛ̃ i kanya fiɛ ɔrui ɔkɛlɛ iyo ne.
Aito aawo karabara gagbe ame ɔwe, alasɔ fɔ ɔtu ame iikpa i Ɣaa anɔ.
Itɔ̃me wɛrɛa nɛgbe nɖe sɔ, Kristo gɔ mpia i mi ame ne, ɔ̃ nɖe ɔriinyɔ ikpawaĩ siare nɛ nse isia mi ne.
Mme Paulo mme losu wũ kɔrɔ̃ loto lotsɛrɛ losese-ɔ sɔ, loto loatã-ɔ kuso gɔmɔ.
Itɔ̃me nɛgbe ɔɖaa ma, ne matsɛ wũ ikarɛ isia isia sɔ, “Loɣe sɔ iiɖe mme ato, ɛɛbɛrɛ mme loɖe?
Ne Simon ɔɣere wũ sɔ, “Pɛ Bosate nrɔɔ̃ i wũ iti sɔ ara nyanyarĩa wa aɣɛ ngbe kuiwɛ̃ iibabɔrɛ me iso!
Gɔ masɛ maabo ngbegɔ masɛ marɔ sɔ, itikui ne, mapɛ Yesu mamatãra i kudziri iso.
Ibara mma lowe i mmɔ ɣaa, ne mato makarɛ so sɔ, “Be igbã iɖe ngbe ne?
” Ɔluwɛ̃ ne, ibara Saulo lɛ akolo lokpa i ɔ̃ anɔmi iso, ne ɔtsɛ ara inya ne.
Ɣɛɛ Yesu ɔɣere wũ sɔ, “Ɔko Sekelea ɔɣɛ sɔ, ‘Daala Bosate Ɣaa anyɔ.
Misɛgu ma i kuwarɛ ame alasɔ mi gu ma i Ɣaa aatã ngbã karatã.
Boisɛ boɣara sɔ boaɣere bo Ɔse Ɣaa kumɛgɔ mito mibara mi kafɔkaɖe karabara.
Midaaɖe mma loikpa anɔ, ɣɛɛ midzuĩ minyɔ sɔ be i Bosate to ɔbie sɔ mibara.
Ne ɔso mitã sɔ mi matɔ̃ɖedze si masiai me maba maɖi ɔ̃ aɣɛrɛ mate.
So ɔɣɔ me gbaã i Bosate ame sɔ i ɔwi dzoroo kama ne, lofɔ karatã lobɔrɛgu i mi kɔrɛ.
Ne ɔso mamɔɛ̃ wũ marɔdɛ̃ matã maturi ma losu wũ makɛlɛgu Egipte karɔ̃ iso.
Alasɔ si mmara iso ibara ame i Ɣaa sɛ ɔnyɔ ɔturi sɔ ɔse bɔlɔlɔ ne, iyɔ Kristo kukpi ɖe siefe.
Ɣɛɛ ɔkɔlɛ ɔ̃ silɔ ɔbua ɔɣɛ sɔ, “Igara David Ɔbi!
” Gɔ karɔ̃ nɖe sɔ, “Wũ Ɣaa, wũ Ɣaa, be ɔso anyua me asɛ ngbɔ?
Bɔrɛ i ɔ̃ ame fe!
Ɔwi gɔmɔ ame ne, ɔkɛlɛ ma Yudase kusarɛkɔ̃ ɔtsɛ ma Yesu iso itɔ̃me iɣere sɔ Ɣaa Ɔbi ɔɖe.
Mmara matedze gu masɔrɛdze makpakpa ɔbie sɔ si mamɔɛ̃ Yesu mmɔ alasɔ maɣe sɔ ma iso ɔpɛ igbã nɛmɔ.
Ne Yesu to ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Lonya Ɔbosam ɔkpase ɔbɔrɛ i kato lɛ kumɛgɔ i kado sɛ ɔma awe.
Katsɔrakɔ̃ ne, ɔɖi so ɔte me gɔ maɣe kamakama.
Kuɖɔɛ gɔgbe ɔbɛ, kukarã, kukɔlɛ, fiɛ kuwodoroo.
Lofɔ loɖe sɔ si ɔwo miawo kɔra ne, tee miɖi mi anɔmi mitã me.
Ɔwi gɔgbe ame ne, mamɔɛ̃ ɔrɛrɛ̃ ɔwɛ̃ gɔ marɔ sɔ Baraba mapia iyo gu mma lota maya ma Romase Igara iso, Gɔ mabara ngbɔ ɔso ne, mamɔɛ̃ ma fiɛ matã ma kukpi ipɔ alasɔ maɖoe maturi.
Ne ɔso Ɣaa kpabo ɖeakatɔ̃ ɔsɛ ɔ̃afedza nnɛ mpia i ɔ̃ irɔi ame ɔfere i kayiiso.
Bo nɖe ɔ̃ iyo si bomɔɛ̃ bo katetere gu kafɔkaɖe i nnɛ boto bonyɔ ɔri bola teteree.
Mila miɔkparama kayi ɔwi biara, fiɛ si mito mikparama kayi ne, mi adzuni ame si anyɔ tuee, mila miɔpɛ Ɣaa siba.
Gɔ kaɖe ɔsɛ̃ fiɛ ɔwiri iito ɔnyua ɔkpɛ̃ ne, matsɛ ato wa i ɔkolo sore iɖi iwiri i ndu ame.
Ɔwi gɔ lofe ame ne, Ɣaa iinyɔ mi nnya, ɣɛɛ kiniɔ ne, Ɣaa ɔɔnyɔ mi nnya.
Ne Yesu ɔmɔɛ̃ ɔrɛrɛ̃ gɔgbe kɔrɔ̃ ɔsa wũ fiɛ ɔɖi wũ ɔri ne.
Mibie mi malaa isɛɛ ne iiɖe mi ɔnɔwɛ̃ ire kere.
Ɔ̃ ɔnɔwɛ̃ saã nɖe Ɖidze, alasɔ ɔ̃ nɖe ngɔ i Ɣaa ɔtã iyere gu ɔle sɔ maturi ɔɖuɖu i kayiiso aaki i ɔ̃ iso mana ngbã.
Siainyɔ ɔyu ɔwi ɔɖuɖu ne, nto loawe i mi kɔrɛ fiɛ ka miaɖi me ɔri loakɛlɛ ngbegɔ loakɛlɛ.
Gbaã ne, lonya inyɛwe nɛ ame i wũ maturi pia i Egipte karɔ̃ iso.
Akisi wagbe ɔɖuɖu pia i ara wa karabara bosɛ bobara aro iso.
Lɛ kumɛgɔ i Mose ɔɣɛ sɔ, ‘Bosate gɔ nɖe mi Ɣaa to ɔ̃asese mi kanyaɖidze mama ɔbɔrɛgu i mi ndɛ̃ lɛ me.
Si misakanya ne, mitsue sɔ lopia i mi ndɛ̃ i Siwarã ame fiɛ Bosate ɔle ana pia i mi ndɛ̃.
Ɔwi gɔ ipɛ lɛ iɖɔwũ iweo-inyɔ ne, kayi ɔbara guduu gbɔgbɔɔgbɔ isɛ iabo lɛ iɖɔwũ itɛ ame.
Alasɔ ɔbiara gɔ nɖe Ɣaa ɔbi sɛ ɔɖe kayi iso.
Kutsue ikpadzɛ̃ iwɛ̃ saã i makpakpɛ̃dze ɔtã bo gu wũ.
Ne ɔso ne, matsɛ ɔri mama gɔ iso maaki fiɛ maamɔɛ̃ wũ ibie.
Ɣɛɛ ɔrɛrɛ̃ gɔgbe iiɣe ngɔ i Yesu ɖe, fiɛ maturi ana ɔsi i mmɔ, ne ɔso Yesu ɔma ɔbo i ma ndɛ̃ ɔrui i mmɔ.
Ngɔ loaɣere ɔ̃ ɔnyiibi sɔ, ‘Ailɛ atã kuira’ ne, makpakpa aaɣɛgu wũ atɔ̃me.
Ifɔ̃ siare ɔmɔɛ̃ ma ne, mato makarɛ so sɔ, “Mme ɔturi igbã ɔɖe ngbe?
Bo ne, boibaɖe ndamu bofe kumɛ, ɣɛɛ boatui i ngbegɔ i Ɣaa ɔsɛ ɔtã bo fiɛ karabara ga bobara i mi ndɛ̃ ana pia i ne ame.
Ne ɔso ne, Ɣaa ɔkɔlɛ wũ kato ɔɖo ira biara, ɔtã wũ iyere nɛ lokɔlɛ iɖo ayere ɔɖuɖu.
Silvano gɔ losɛ lowarɛ lɛ fɔɖedze gɔ nɣɛ teteree lobuai me lotsɛrɛ ɔko gɔgbe.
Ifɔ̃ ɔmɔɛ̃ marɔ̃go gbaã ne ɔso mabɔ ma ati karɔ̃ matã ma.
Ɣɛɛ mabɔrɛ i bo ndɛ̃ si ite sekelee sɔ ma kuwɛ̃ iiɖe bo ndɛ̃ ɔwɛ̃.
Mma nto mama ne, masɛ lɛ mma loito mana isoɣɔ.
Mibuai mma lonya ibuai si mina ɔtu mitã ɔturi biara.
Ɔfuĩdza aɣɛ ɔpia i iwo gudua wodoroa ame, ɔsɛ̃ ne kanya kpa, fiɛ ka ɔsu itsuebi ɔsɛ̃ iwo kanya sɔ si ɔ̃isibana ɔri ɔkɔ nɖebi ɔyura gbɔgbɔɔgbɔ akɔ kakpi kama.
Maɣɛ nnɛgbe sɔ Ɣaa maturi aawe ɔdzini i ma inyɛwe ame ku kafɔkaɖe.
Maɖe ika i ara wa i Itɔ̃me Bielea maɣɛdze to maɣere mi kiniɔ iki i Siwarã Bielea dzɛ i Ɣaa ɔsese ɔbɔrɛgu i kato ɔle iso.
Miɔnina ɔwi gbodzoo ku ɔwi gɔ lofe mibara ara wa i maɣɔsɔrɛdze sɛ maɖɔɛ ibara.
Ɣɛɛ Yesu ɔɣere wũ sɔ, “Matsɛrɛ mapia i Ɔko Sekelea ame sɔ, ‘Iiɖe aɖera ɔnɔwɛ̃ iso i ɔturi aasɛ ngbã.
Yesu ɔwe i Betania ɔmagɛ̃ ame i Simon gɔ lonyɛ ɔnyɛ rɛtɛa iyo.
I Yopa ne, ɔrɔ̃go ɔwɛ̃ pia marɔ sɔ Tabita.
Ne ɔwi gɔ maba ngbe, i itɔ̃me nɛgbe ɔso ne, loinina ɔwi ɖuɖuuɖu.
Ɣaa ɔkarã irɔĩ iso sɔ ɔ̃abara David ɔwa tɛtɛ ɔɖe sigara i David sigaraiyara iso.
Ɔ̃ kayiribielea ana iiɖe siefe, alasɔ loɔbara karabara teteree loɖo katɔ̃memasɛdze tsɔra ɔɖuɖu, ɣɛɛ iiɖe mme mɔmɔ ɔle ame lobara, ɣɛɛ Ɣaa ɔle gɔ nto ɔbara karabara i wũ ame ɔɖe.

Ɣɛɛ gɔ lonya sɔ nnɛ mabara iikotegu nnɛ mpia i Itɔ̃me Bielea ame ne, loɣere Petro i ma ɔɖuɖu katɔ̃ sɔ, “Si fɔ ngɔ fɔ nɖe ɔ Yudase ɔsɛ ngbã lɛ ngɔ loiɖe ɔ Yudase ne, be ɔso fiɛ ato aɣiɛ mma loiɖe ma Yudase sɔ masɛ ngbã lɛ ma Yudase?
Ne ɔso minyua mila ɔla, si ɔbiara si ɔɣere ɔ̃ ɔlaa ɔnukuare alasɔ mi ɔɖuɖu ne, Kristo kuturidziri iso ara miɖe.
Gɔ marasuãdze ɔnya nnɛgbe ne, ikpɛ̃ ma sikpã.
Lofɔ loɖe i Bosate iyere ame sɔ mme mɔmɔ to loaba mi kɔrɛ i ɔwi kurukutu ame.
Bosate Yesu mɔmɔ ɔɖe loɖe katɔ̃ ɔpɛ iɖi nɛgbe imomo fiɛ mma lonɔ ne fiɛ boawo ma ɔfɔ ɔɖe ɔba maaɣere bo.
I ɔri gɔgbe igbã iso ne, ɔrɔ̃go fɔɖedze ɣee ɔrɛrɛ̃ fɔɖedze ba ɔri ɔ̃abara nnɛ ɔɖɔɛ.
Pɛgu maturi si asa ma abara awawãra gbodzoo i fɔ Ɔɖabo Sekelea Yesu iyere ame.
Sosina ame ɔwe o-o siwarã ame ɔwe o-o ne, loibawo ɔtsue, ɣɛɛ Ɣaa ɔ̃ ɔɣe.
gɔ ɔse nɖe Eber gɔ ɔse nɖe Sala.
Ɣɛɛ ne, kɛlɛ aasu so te Ɣaa sɔrɛdze si atã ara wa i Mose mmara ɔkarɛ si ite maturi sɔ ka ase sekelee.
Ayi kurukutu kama ne, bosa bo ara kanya boɣo Yerusalem ɔri.
Iito bo ɔkã sɔ boasu so bokateragu mma nto makɔlɛ so kato sɔ mafe inya.
Karatã ga misese me mikigu i Epafrodito iso ɔba kaapɛgu me kɔrɔ̃, ne ɔso kuira iisinya me.
Si ɔsande aɖe atã ɔturi fiɛ Ɣaa ɔkpere-ɔ ne, idaaɖa-ɔ.
Maledza wũ iɖi sɔ ɔ̃aɖe ikparĩ nɛ iso i maturi aaɖe ika mata maya.
Ita i Igara David iso isɛ iabo ɔwi gɔ mamɔɛ̃ Israel mabi makɛlɛgu sisande ame i Babilonia karɔ̃ iso ne, mawa ma nto maba i ngbe lowe ne.
Ibara Pilato ɣii gɔ ɔnɔ sɔ Yesu ɔkpi mala ngbɔ.
Misore wũ nsɛgbai lɛ kumɛgɔ mme wũ nto losore Kristo nsɛgbai.
Mmɔ i Pilato ɔkarɛ Yesu sɔ, “Fɔ nɖe ma Yudase Igara ne?
Si masia manyɛse nrɔɔ̃ i ati ne, maana isosarɛ.
Gɔ mma loki malɔ wũ ɔsi ɔso ne, ɔya ɔbo ɔsɛ i ɔkolo ame i ndu iso.
” Itɔ̃me wɛrɛa nɛ mpia i Ɣaa itɔ̃me nɛgbe ame ɔwodoro, ɣɛɛ mme lonya sɔ Kristo gu ɔ̃ mafɔɖedze iso iɖe ɔɖe ika.
Ɔsɛgu maturi gbodzoo ma i masɔrɛdze makpakpa gu kaɖe makpakpa ɔpia fiɛ mato atekpe gu kudziriku.
Mmɔ i Yesu to ɔɣere wũ sɔ, “Matsɛrɛ i Ɔko Sekelea ame sɔ ne, ‘Bosate Ɣaa ɔnɔwɛ̃ nɖe ngɔ lokote sɔ maapɛ agɛgɛ̃ matã, masɔrɛ.
Mma nto maɣa ara ne, mabara lɛ ara wa maɣa iiɖe ma mɔmɔ are.
Ɔbiara gɔ loaɣɛ sɔ ɔpia i Ɣaa ame ne, ikote sɔ ɔ̃asɛ ngbã lɛ kumɛgɔ i Yesu Kristo ɔsɛ.
Nto loɣere mi gbaã sɔ loisibanɛ ndã gbɔgbɔɔgbɔ iyi nɛ loanɛgu mi miɣɛtɛ i wũ Ɔse sigarakaɖekɔ̃.
Kɔsiɖa kaya tutuutu ne, marɔ̃go magbe ɔta makɛlɛ maturi kabiarakɔ̃ ku ara wa maaledza wũ ala.
Ne ɔso mi nrɔɔ̃ mɛ loɔfɛfɛ̃ gu agɛgɛ̃ wa lobara nyɔkɔ̃tɔɔ̃ ne, mipia wã ɔle.
Ne ɔso la ɔba ɔ̃aya i ɔrɔ̃go gɔ i kuɣe to kuɖoɖo katɔ̃ sɔ si ɔnya ɔɣe ɔbi ne, si ɔ̃asu ɔbi ɔme.
Ne Bokɔse ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Si mi kafɔkaɖe ɔmɔ lɛ susuruba ibi ne, miaɣere kudziri gɔgbe sɔ, ‘Rui ngbe kɛlɛ ɔpo ame.
Ɔwi gɔ ɔto ɔtsuedza kua kɔrɔ̃kɔrɔ̃a mmɔ ne, masumudze tsɔra ɣɛ i inyamɔ mato makparama kayi.
Ɔsu wũ ɔbara Ɔkpakpa gu Ɖidze sɔ Israel kaɖe ana ɔri mafiniki i ma situ ame mana akpi isu itsɛ.
Mɔɛ̃ fɔ kafɔkaɖe gu fɔ kaɣere la kukaakɔ alasɔ mawɛ̃ ma loikã ma situ atsue ne, mayu ngbã ɔri.

Ɔto ɔ̃aɣe ɔbirɛrɛĩ, tã wũ iyere sɔ Yesu, alasɔ ɔ̃ loaɖi ɔ̃ maturi ɔbɔrɛgu i ma akpi ame ne.
Ɣaa kato gu karɔ̃ baradze ɣɛɛ ne, ɔ̃isɛ ɔsɛ i ayo wa i maturi awune ɔtsue ame.
Ngɔ loɖi wũ ɔtã ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Ngɔ minya sɔ loya fiɛ lofiɔ̃ irɛkpo ne, ɔ̃ ɔɖe ne, mimɔɛ̃ wũ!
Ne maɣere wũ sɔ, “Bo ne, boinɔ kuira i fɔ iso.
Ne ɔso ne, masɛ maabusi isã makigu nyɛse masora wũ i ɔkala ame masɛ i Yesu katɔ̃.
” Ne ɔso ne, manyagalagu wũ, managu wũ sikpã.
Gɔ tee ka miaɖe aɖera wa mba ɔle ne, mikpese mitogu inyɛ imɛmɛ.
Gɔ Yesu ɔnya maturi gbodzoo ma nsiai wũ ne, ɔya ɔsɛ ɔ̃asɛ i kabemi iso fiɛ ɔ̃ marasuãdze ɔba maasɛ wũ i kɔrɛ.
Mato maaɣɛ sɔ, ‘Mme nɖe wũ’ fiɛ ‘Ɔwi ɔɔɣo.
Sikaniɛ aka akɔdzɛ ɔmɔɛ̃ sito i sigaraiyara katɔ̃.
Gɔ iɔkuti kɛkɛĩ fiɛ ɔ̃abo iyo mmɔ ne, ɔkpakpa gɔgbe ɔpia ɔ̃ malaa sɔ masɛ maaɣere wũ sɔ, “Tete, loito lobie sɔ loaɖa-ɔ.
Ne ɔso mitere ise sɔ miaɖe iso mifɔ ikoto.
Ne kama ne, ɔɣere bo sɔ boba boaɣɛ itɔ̃me i fɔ katɔ̃.
Karabara ga i Tete ɔtã me sɔ lobara loro ne, kã nsɛ kaɖe me aɖansiɛ sɔ ɔ̃ lopia me katɔ̃me ne.
-Ne Paulo ɔtsɔra ma ɔɣere sɔ, “Mitsue sɔ, itɔ̃me nɛ i Ɣaa sɔ ɔ̃asu ɔɖi ala maturi ne, maɔsu ne makɛlɛgu mma loiɖe ma Yudase.
Ɔwi gɔ mabiara wũ ne, ɔnyɔ nyanyarĩ, ɖɔbɔrɔɔ, ɣɛɛ ɔwi gɔ ame ɔ̃ata ɔbɔrɛ i makpise ame ne, ɔ̃are situri fiɛ ɔ̃awe ɔle ana.
Ne ɔso gɔ lorɛ i iyo ala Bosate karabara ɔso ne, loto mi i kukpa sɔ mi nsɛgbai si mikotegu ngbã mɛ ɔso i Ɣaa ɔkpere mi.
Mma ɔɖuɖu nɣe Yesu gu marɔ̃go ma losiai wũ mabɔrɛ i Galilea ɔya dzoroo manyɔ ara wa lokɛlɛ i katɔ̃.
Iyo biara ba ngɔ lotsue ne, ɣɛɛ gbaã ne, Ɣaa nɖe ngɔ lotsue ira biara.
Fiɛ si ɔnya ne ne, ɔto ɔ̃akpere ɔ̃ mala gu magbamikui ɔsirakanya ɔɣere ma sɔ, ‘So ɔɣɔ me gbaã alasɔ lonya wũ sikã ibi nɛ loyu ne ɔso minagu me isoɣɔ.
Iikote sɔ ɔ̃asu ɔ̃ kurabarara ɔkateragu ɔmama kure.
Ɔturi gɔ nsigu so loɖe fiɛ lona i kuwɛ̃ kayirinɔ.
” Ɔɣere ma nnɛgbe ɔɖi waĩ, fiɛ manɔ wũ karɔ̃ ana.
Manyii, iisinya sɔ loatsɛrɛ mi ɔko i ɔwi ɣee ayi ara wa loaba iso.
Yohanes se lɛ ɔkaniɛ gɔ losa, fiɛ miɖɔɛ ɔwi kurukutu sɔ miawe i ɔ̃ ikpawaĩ ame ku isoɣɔ.
Ɔrɔ̃go biara si ɔbɔ so karɔ̃ si ɔsuã ara i karɔ̃ ibɔso ɔɖuɖu ame.
Ayi kɛkɛĩ kama ne, Felike gu ɔ̃ ɔre Drusila gɔ nɖe ɔ Yudase ɔba, ne matã sɔ maɖi Paulo mabɔ fiɛ ɔɣere ma itɔ̃me i Yesu Kristo kafɔkaɖe iso ne.
Ne Bosate ɔkɛlɛ i katɔ̃ ɔɣere ma sɔ, “Minɔ nnɛ i atɔ̃meɣɛdze lalaa gɔgbe to ɔɣɛ.
Kumɛgɔ Mato Masɔrɛ Ɣaa I Ɔ̃ Sigarakaɖekɔ̃.
Alasɔ idududu kato ife iro fiɛ ikpawaĩ mɔmɔ ka ito ifiɛ koko.
Ne lonya Ɣaa kpabo ɔwɛ̃ ɔso ɔbɔrɛ i kato ɔto ɔba ɔto iwo gudua wodoroa sibɔi gu kunyiborei siare i kɔrɔ̃.
Mato maapɛ mi i ma Yudase kasarɛkɔ̃ ala wũ ɔso, mito miaya i matɔ̃ɖedze gu magara anɔ miɣere ma wũ iso itɔ̃me, si iɖe ikparĩ itã ma.
Alasɔ si fɔ sosina kakɔi kawɛ̃ ɔkpɛti ne, ilɛ iɖo sɔ Ɣaa asu fɔ kuturidziri ɔɖuɖu ɔpia i itɔkpe nɛ loisɛ inyi ame.
Na isoɣɔ gbaã alasɔ afɔ kanya ga i Ɣaa kpabo ɔba ɔ̃aɣere-ɔ aɖe sɔ iaba ɔso.
Koko ɔwi ne, Ɣaa Kanyaɖidze Yesaya ɔtsɛrɛ ɔsɛ sɔ Ɣaa ɔɣɛ i ɔ̃ Ɔbi iso sɔ.
Si ɔrere ɔnina ne ne, Ɣaa to ɔ̃awɔra ɔnyiiɔ gɔmɔ ɔ̃ wũ.
Kato makpabo ɔso ne, ikote sɔ ɔrɔ̃go aasu ɖuku ɔnyi iti si ɔte sɔ ɔpia i ɔ̃ ɔrã kayirinɔ.
Kuwɛ̃ iiwo isɔrɛyo ame ɔbo gbɔgbɔɔgbɔ inyɛwe aka akɔdzɛ wa i Ɣaa makpabo ikɔdzɛ mamɔ ɔbɔ ɔfe aro.
Ɣaa kpabo ɔla kulu teteree ɔɣɛ sɔ, “Minigã Ɣaa si misu kuwarɛ mitã wũ, alasɔ ɔwi ɔɔɣo sɔ ɔ̃aɣɛgu kayiiso maturi atɔ̃me.
Gɔ Yesu ɔbɔrɛ i Yordan ɔwore ame ne, Siwarã Bielea ɔyi i ɔ̃ ame, ne si kɔ wũ sikɛlɛgu fafuĩ ame ne.
Ɣɛɛ gɔ matsue ne, makpese masɛ maaɣere matsɔra.
Maturi gbodzoo siai wũ alasɔ kumɛgɔ ɔto ɔsa sinyɛ ɔbara ma ɣii.
Ne ɔso misu so mipia i Ɣaa kɔrɔ̃ teterea kayirinɔ i karɔ̃ ibɔso ame si ɔ̃akɔlɛ mi kato i ɔ̃ ɔwi sɛɛ iso.
Maturi gbodzoo ɔba ɔ̃ kɔrɛ fiɛ ɔtsɛ ma Itɔ̃me Bielea ite.
Gɔ mabo ne, mawɛ̃ ɔɣere Yesu sɔ Simon masɔrɔ̃go rɛ ɔto ɔnyɛ ɔbe ɔtɔ.
Ɔle ame bosɛ i ndu kuruɛ kuruɛ bosɛ boabo kakɔi ga marɔ “Sikolo Katuikɔ̃ Sɛɛ” gɔ loidzorogu ɔmagɛ̃ gɔ marɔ Lasea.
Fiɛ si ita nɛmɔ ɔkpase iwuĩ ɔrere ne, ito iakɔtɛ wũ ɖɛkpɛrɛɛ.
Iiɖe maturi inɔgba ame i nnɛgbe ɔbɔrɛ, ɣɛɛ Ɣaa nsɛ ɔnyɔ bo nnya sɔ boabusi bo situ boɣere mi ɔnukuare.
Kado imama gu kado iɖu gu silɔ agbãagbã to abɔrɛ i sigaraiyara ame.
Bo ma ɔɖuɖu i kuira iifu i adzuni iso ne, bosɛ boɖi Bosate ikpawaĩ bote kukaakɔ.
